sanskrit: brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśśiva eva ca * * * * * * * * parātparataraṃ param śivastu parataḥ tasmāt paratastu parātparaḥ makāro rudra ityāhuḥ bījamīśvara eva ca śaiṣāścaiva hi ye tatvā parātparatarāḥ sthitāḥ oṃkāraṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ yattadvedamukhaṃ smṛtam akārokārayogena oṃkāraṃ parikīrtitam induśca paratastasya makāropari saṃsthitaḥ nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva ca oṃkāreṇa makārastu spṛṣṭo vai nadate yadā kakārādimakārāntāḥ caturviṃśatkalāsmṛtāḥ siddhārtha kā * * kāraṃ bindudevasya lakṣaṇam m kārasadṛśākāraṃ oṃkārasya tu mūrdhani tasyā'pi paramaṃ yacca nādarūpī sadāśivaḥ ataḥ paratarannāsti śivātparataśca yat ādimadhyāyatañcaiva tripañca savisargakam caturthādaparaścaiva gṛhītātparasaptamam ādimādantimaṃ yacca adhastvaikādaśaśca yat * * * * * catvāraḥ kalāsthāstā vijānataḥ yakārādi kṣakārāntāśśivatatve vyavasthitāḥ yadetatkathitaṃ deva oṃkāraṃ sarvadaivatam cittañceto tathā cintā cintyo'nya cintakastathā kīdṛśantu bhaveccittañcetā caiva kīdṛśam etatsarvaṃ punaḥ brūhi tatvataḥ parameśvara avadhānaṃ smṛtiścittaṃ cetā bodha prakārakam

evaṃ pañca prakāreṇa vijñāya parameśvarī adyāpi saṃśayo deva yogasya parameśvara evametatsamākhyātaṃ yogināṃ yogamuttamam lakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu vai samyak vettā tatsthaṃ niyojayet sukhaduḥkhena saṃvetti karaṇaiśca vivarjitaḥ eṣa te yoga ākhyātaḥ parañca paramañca yat oṃ buddhīmanohaṃkāraścaitā jīvaśca pañcamaḥ praṇavo bindubandho hi suṣumnānādagocare sa eṣa vāṅmayo deva mantrapañcāṃśadavyayaḥ svabhāvassaṃsthitastatra brahmānāmnā sa viśrutaḥ upāṃśūccāryamāṇastu viṣṇustatrādhi daivatam ātmā dhyātā mano dhyānaṃ dhyeyaśśuddho maheśvaraḥ tasmin svadehe deveśi ātmā dhyānena yojayet tasyānte tu śivaṃ kṛtvā sametā mokṣadaṃ padam sa gacchet paramaṃ sthānaṃ kulakoṭiśatairyutaḥ avaśyaṃ mucyate devi sarvasyānugrahe kṣamaḥ mucyate paśya deveśi yantraṇārahitopayaḥ darśanāsparśanāccāre jñeyaṃ dhyānena yoginām taṃ pravakṣyāmyahaṃ devi yatsurairapi durlabham vedarūpo hi so'vaśyaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam puna * saṃdigdha utpannaḥ śiva omiti smṛtaḥ trikapañcānvitaścaiva śivomiti vidhīyate saṃjñābhiḥ sthānabhede tu kathayasva * * * * rajārakṣāratiḥ pālyā kāmā saṃyaminī kriyā tamo mohākṣudhā nidrā mṛtyurmāyā bhayā jarā

śaśinī aṅgadā iṣṭā marīcijvālinī tathā ardhacandraśca śaktiśca kalābhissaha jānataḥ śaktisthā yā mayā proktā vyāpinīṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet * katvaṃ yo na jānāti nirodhī rodhate yadā sa eva ūrdhvagāmī tu nādasyāntarbahisthitā sā eva vyāpinī caiva śakteścāntarbahisthitā vedanīyāstu tā nityaṃ śivatantrānuvartibhiḥ anirdeśyamanākhyañca samo * ssarvatasthitaḥ devairapi na vijñātaṃ kiṃ tadastīti bhāvanā pratyakṣā sarvalokeṣu dṛśyate sarvataḥ sthitā śrūyate satataṃ devi nādākhyeti ca viśrutam ardhacandramiti proktaṃ vyāpī cānte bahisthitaḥ rodhate sarvayogīnāmardhacandreti viśrutam indriyādiṣu sarveṣu jñeyaḥ parataraḥ sthitaḥ niṣkalaṃ praṇavaṃ deva tvayā pūrvamudāhṛtam avagṛhṇāti bhūtāni mantrarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ paśupāśaṃ jaganmūlaṃ paśupāśātmakaṃ smṛtam vidyadarkāyutaprakhyaḥ sarvabhūtānukaṃpanaḥ vyāpinī vyomarūpā cānantānāthānaśrutā(anāśritā) īśānapuruṣā ghoravāmasadyādigrahaḥ praṇavaḥ sakalo devaḥ sarvavidyādhipaḥ prabhuḥ praṇavastanurīśānaṃ dhṛtaṃ mantreśvareśvaram tāvatsuragaṇāssarve abhivyaktā bhavanti te praṇavaḥ sarvadharmātmā praṇavāsaktacetasaḥ praṇave ca jagatsarvaṃ śabdādyaṃ yacca tatparam

praṇavaḥ prāṇānāṃ prāṇaḥ pramāṇaparivarjitam mantrarūpasamūhastu tatsvarūpaparaśśivaḥ tallayañca jagatsarvamavabudhyasva tatvataḥ nityatvādantaratvācca prāguktātpraṇavasmṛtaḥ praṇavaṃ tasya kurvanti tenā'sau praṇavasmṛtaḥ vidyādehaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ ādyaṃ yatpārameśvaram sākāyakāraśuddhyarthaṃ sa ca mokṣasya kāraṇam sarvavyāpī paro devaḥ praṇavaḥ sarvakartṛṇām tisro mātrā'rdhamātrā ca praṇavo'nādisaṃbhavam saṃvedyaścaiva yājyaśca sa dhyeyo japya eva ca pratyekasādhanañcaiva mantavyaḥ praṇavassadā dhyānamātreṇa deveśi nissaṃdigdhaṃ varānane hṛdisthā devatāssarvā hṛdi prāṇe vyavasthitiḥ etaisstribhissamāyuktassarvabhūte vyavasthitaḥ cittaṃ śarīramākhyātaṃ cetā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā tathā hi lakṣyate devi etairhīnastu cetanaḥ praṇavaḥ paramaḥ sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇaṃ parivarjitam eṣu vai praṇavo jñeyaḥ kṣetrajñasya tu sārathī sa śabdaḥ praṇavo jñeyo sarvamāpūrya tiṣṭhati pañcāśatpraṇavā devi bhedenaikena kīrtitā vedasāṃkhyapurāṇeṣu pāñcarātretihāsayoḥ omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vadante sarvayoginaḥ pañcāśatpraṇavā deva jñātaṃ me tvatprasādataḥ bhūyo'haṃ śrotumicchāmi saṃśayo me maheśvara vidyeśā lokapālāśca astrāṇi ca yathākramam

śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ mantrasadbhāvamuttamam akārastu bhavenantaḥ prathamaṃ yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ tṛtīyaṃ kalpayetpadmaṃ sānusvārañca sadbhavet makāraḥ karṇikā'khyātaṃ tasya padmasya nityaśaḥ oṃkārāntena deveśi puṣkarāntena kalpayet kesarāste tu vijñeyāḥ tasya padmasya śobhane nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva ca vāyavyamāditaḥ kṛtvā śakārāntātpratiṣṭhitāḥ ṣakārastu bhavennetraṃ sā gāyatrī prakīrtitā saṃpūjya devadeveśi haṃsākhyaṃ ca sadāśivam tena saṃcintya deveśaṃ pūjayeta yathākramam tṛtīye lokapālāṃśca caturthe'strāṇi vinyaset jhakārādi takārāntā lokapālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ akāreṇa samāyuktā vidyeśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ praṇavena tu sarveṣāṃ gandhadhūpavidhikramāt praṇavena tu kāryāṇi sarvāṇyuktāni yāni vai pṛthivyādi śivāntañca ye tatvāḥ parikīrtitāḥ kartavyaṃ sarvakāryāṇi japadhyānādireva ca eṣa te mātṛkā yāgo durlabhaḥ tridaśairapi vrajate śivasāyujyaṃ nirmalo vigatajvaraḥ tasyā'pi cedṛśaṃ proktaṃ yāgaṃ devena śobhane jayātmakam māse varṣaśataṃ proktaṃ māse dva * * * * * japārcanavidhānena abdenaikena siddhyati (pūrva) vinyaseddevadeveśi yāvatsarvaṃ samāpyate

kṣakāraikena kartavyaṃ saptadhā * * * * * rudrabījasamāyuktā ṣaḍaṅgena samanvitā eke mṛtyuñjayaṃ teṣu catuṣṣaṣṭyā samāsataḥ dhyānañca satataṃ kuryāt mārgaviccakrasaṃsthitaḥ dhyānena manasā * * * * * * na saṃśayaḥ saṃpuṭaṃ cintayeccamupariṣṭhāddvitīyakam eṣa te kathito devi cakramṛtyuñjayaṃ prati punareva pravakṣyāmi dīkṣāñcakre varānane saṃhṛtya sarvasaṃhāraṃ vidhiṃ kuryātsamāsataḥ pūjyasaṃskāraśudhyarthaṃ paśūnāṃ laṃbhanaṃ tathā kramamanasālokya dhyāyeccaiva yathākramam dhyātvā cakraṃ yathāvasthaṃ karmakuryādyathākramam tyavicakṣaṇaḥ śataṃ śatañca hotavyaṃ pūrṇāhutyā krameṇa tu tatra pūrṇāhutirdeyā punaranyeṣu yojayet * * * vakenaiva deveśi * * * lasmṛtaḥ eṣa yāgavidhānantu na dadyādyasya kasyacit * * * * jvaratyakto svaśarīreṇa suvrate etadguhyāntaraṃ sarvamāpremātula * * * aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ mantraṃ vinyasya yatnataḥ yadiṣṭaṃ taṃ yajenmantrī sidhyato nātra saṃśayaḥ hṛccakre devatā nyāsaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ varānane etadguhyatamaṃ devi na deyaṃ parikīrtitam tarkānumānabudhyā tu nigṛhyārthīva śāsanam triguṇassaguṇovā'pi sarvāvastho'pi deśikaḥ

nyāsaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā proktaṃ sūtra uttarasaṃjñite na kuryādanyathā devi ājñaiṣā pārameśvarī mṛtyunāśanahetvarthaṃ sa snigdhaphalabhāk bhavet nāḍisañcāratatvajñaḥ sa mṛtyuṃ vijayiṣyati dhū * * varānena ha suṣimnābhinnamastakam sa mukta iti vijñeyaśśeṣādyātmaviḍaṃbakāḥ dharmādharmānna lipyeta sa sarvānugṛhe kṣamaḥ vibhaktiṃ naiva vidyeta yathāgnāvagnireva hi vibhāgo naiva vidyeta tatvamiśvara bhāvitam vivekantu na śakyante rasabhāvaṃ pṛthak pṛthak śivabhāva samāyukto tulyametannasaṃśayaḥ sa pacyennaro ghoreṣu dvātriṃśannarakeṣu ca dinatrayantu rudrasya prāyaścittīyate naraḥ vivekī gacchate'dhastāt avivekī * * * jet tvayā guptataraṃ kāryaṃ na dadyā paradīkṣite athavā satya eva syāt viditārādhi toryadā na likhetpuṇyapāpebhyo satyaṃ devi udāhṛtam sarve te praṇavā jñeyāḥ kāmamuktiphalapradāḥ yena iṣṭo iṣṭaṃ vā a * * * * * * * * yathā sā sādhanā tatra mātṛkā * * * * * * sa evaṃ saṃsthito nityaṃ dehī dehatvamāgataḥ sa eva nālamityuktaṃ ādhāraṃ sarvadehinām abhayoreva jānīyāt saṃpuṭaṃ paramaṃ mahat ekaikamakṣaraṃ vidyāt patre patre yathākramam makāraṃ karṇikā jñeyā tasya padmasya madhyataḥ

eṣa padmavidhiprokto hṛtpadmasya viśeṣataḥ vidhimeva sakṛt jñātvā na bhūyo janmatāṃ vrajet evaṃ sarveṣu padmeṣu hṛdistho yāti nityaśaḥ tasya madhye tu cātmānamadhaścordhvamavasthitam bhuṅkte tu vividhān bhogān dharmādharmeṣvavasthitaḥ tadvaddehasthito dehī pūrake recake'pi ca sa eva cetanā'tmasthaḥ ceṣṭā hyetāni kārayet prerakaḥ sarvabhūteṣu indriyaiśca viśeṣataḥ dharmiṣṭhānāntu dharmiṣṭhaḥ pāpiṣṭhānāntu pāpakṛt evaṃ paśupatiścāyaṃ sarvaprāṇiṣu saṃsthitaḥ khadyotamiva nābhāti pramāṇamicchayā smṛtam manaśca cetanaścaiva sa eva parigīyate jñeyaṃ manaśca cetā ca kathayasva vibhāgataḥ jīvante sarvabhūtāni jīvasteneha kīrtitaḥ bhramate bhramamāṇastu paśustenaiva kīrtitaḥ dhyāyate pūjyate yasmāt tasmācchiva iti smṛtaḥ astīti bhāvanā yasmāt tasmāt jñeyamiti smṛtam prerakasteṣu sarveṣu manasthaḥ parameśvaraḥ || iti sparśitaṃ vedate yasmāttasmāccetā iti smṛtaḥ aṅguṣṭhādyāvamūrdhāntaṃ nītvā śivapadaṃ vrajet aṣṭamena hi tatvena jātavedo dvayena ca adhomukhantu yatpadmaṃ vartate nityameva hi yathā ca bhedamāyānti adhaḥ padmo varānane daśagranthi vibhedantu kṣurikāto yadā bhavet bhāskaraprabhave mārge dhyātavyaṃ jyotimaṇḍalam

tattejo'ntarhitaṃ kṛtvā svamārgaṃ pūrakeṇa tu śikhāpañcasamopetaṃ dhyātavyaṃ yogibhissadā nirdhūmāgnau patatyeva śiṣyate ca muhurmuhuḥ āpūrya kuṃbhakenaiva citrākāraṃ vicintayet tatastenaiva mārgeṇa śanairecaka suvrate evaṃ krameṇa deveśi yāvanmūrdhni samāhatam vegenākṣipatastatra mūrchā kaṃpaśca jāyate punarāpyāyanaṃ kuryāt mūrchākaṃpaṃ vināśayet cintayetplāvayatyevaṃ tata āpyāyateddhruvam sidhyate yena yo bhinnaṃ mārgavidvijacintakaḥ evamabhyāsato devi dvimārgaṃ pravahena tu yadā nirvedamāpanno dṛṣṭvā cañcalamātmanaḥ tadā nirvāṇamabhyeti chinnapāśanibandhanaḥ saptāhāttu kramedvaśyaṃ nātrakāryā vicāraṇā hṛcchikārasamāyukta utkramannātrasaṃśayaḥ eṣa ante prakurvīta anyathā na kadācana mṛtyuliṅgaṃ yadā jñātaṃ tadā etatprayojayet vidyābhāvā'tha gacchetāḥ sa * * * * vartayet aṅguṣṭhādyāvanmūrdhāntaṃ tāvatpadamanāmayam mūrtidhyānaṃ samāśritya tvā * * * * * * * jīvantamayatāṃ sthāpya gacchetpadamanāmayam tadvattadātmako yogī bindurmaṇiriva grathet pūritaṃ kuṃbhakenaiva tadā cordhvamukhaṃ bhavet sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthā somaścāgneśca madhyagāḥ sthūlañcākṣararūpeṇa sūkṣmaṃ bindusamāśritam

nādāntarnihitā śaktiḥ śaktyatītastu niṣkalaḥ akṣaraprakṛtijñeyā tadatītastu niṣkalaḥ nipatanti tridhābhūtā prakṛtiḥ sā parā parā jihvāgre triraṇaṃ viddhi nisṛtāṃ mātṛkāṃ viduḥ likhyate paṭhyate naiva aṇurnādena veṣṭitaḥ śivatatvantu boddhavyaṃ varṇe varṇe vyavasthitam śaktiśca śāntatā caiva boddhavyamanupūrvaśaḥ ātmatattvāgato yena ākarastena cocyate māyayā mohayatyeṣa makārastena cocyate prāṇo bhūtvā haratyūrdhvaṃ hakārastena cocyate binduhīnāstathā varṇā susvaranna prakāśayet tatrasthaṃ cintayedyogī śikhāṃ tāluprabhedinīm śivatejodbhavā śaktiḥ varṇe varṇe vyavasthitā tatvena vitatāssarve tantubhistu yathā paraḥ ghṛtamadhyasamo nādaḥ śaktirvīryamiva sthitaḥ vyāpakassarva * *? nāṃ guruvaktrāttu labhyate anayā devi vijñātaṃ pareṇa saha saṃyutam tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatvato jñātumarhasi susvare ca samākhyātaḥ tatra rudro vyavasthitaḥ āyate devadeveśi nādākhyaḥ sa sadāśivaḥ bhāgamekaṃ śivasthāne aṅgeṣveva dvitīyakam caturthantu tato bāhye pañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca adhunā dehagaṃ devi kathayāmi yathā sthitā tālumadhye samākhyātaṃ susvarākhyaṃ varānane tasyopari śikhā vyoma nādākhyassa sadāśivaḥ

svadehe devi jñātavyā devatā bhavanāśanā evaṃ ṣaṭ trividhaṃ jñātvā pañca vyomā parā sthitā tasya sthānaṃ na vaktavyaṃ sa sarvatra vyavasthitaḥ pañcavyomapadātītaṃ yadā prāpyati tatpadam yadā gurumukhāddevi vijñātaṃ pārameśvaram cintāhīnaśca yo devi sa sarvatra vyavasthitaḥ tena hīnā na sidhyanti na ca yānti paraṃ padam na ca tena vinā siddhiḥ pūjayādhvarakarmaṇi pañca vyomātmake dehe śaktirūpeṇa bhāvyate tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi yoniḥ pṛthak pṛthak bījaṃ vyoma ityabhidhīyate sthitāste vyomavaddevi tena vyometi kīrtitāḥ tena sā devi ākhyātā vyomavyāpī paraśśivaḥ tādṛśaṃ varṇarūpeṇa devadevamupāsyate varṇayogaṃ yadā khyātaṃ tatsthānālaya bhogabhuk saṃyogātmaikamantreṇa kathaṃ mokṣo vidhīyate paśumākṛṣyamātmasthaḥ prayāti paramaṃ padam tenānityā mahādevaḥ kathaṃ nityatvatā bhavet na saṃyogādbahirmantro jihvoṣṭhapuṭavarjitaḥ icchāśaktirmaheśasya mantrātmāvasthitasya ca uttameṣvuttamaṃ bhuṅkte madhyame madhyamaṃ tathā deśikatve samāsthāya paśuṃ gṛhya varānane adhamo yogibhogādiṃ bhuñjate parameśvaraḥ madhyame tātvikaṃ bhogaṃ bhuktantu parameśvaraḥ tṛtīyaṃ uttaraṃ bhogamiti vāritasarvabhuk

krīḍate mantrarūpī so vṛścike pannageṣu ca tena tena hi bhāvena krīḍante parameśvaraḥ saṃśayo me mahādeva prasādī bhava śūladhṛk mātṛkāsaṃbhavāssarve nāsti mantramataḥ param vedanīyāstu te sarve śivatatvānuvartibhiḥ parato yanmayā proktassarveṣāṃ vyāpakasmṛtaḥ ekākṣarasmṛto mantro dvyakṣarāstryakṣarāḥ parāḥ bahvakṣarā ye deveśi mantrāste saṃprakīrtitāḥ saṃyogena vihīnāstu na te mantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tadevādau namaścānte saṃyogaṃ samudāhṛtam saṃyogena vihīnāstu mantraśabdabahiṣkṛtāḥ vyāpakena samāyuktaṃ saṃpatantaṃ vinirdiśet svaramantraṃ vijānīyādvisargeṇa visargajāḥ pañcadhā saṃsthitān jñātvā tataḥ karma samārabhet prerakassarvamantreṣu svaśaktibalavardhanaḥ śrotumicchāmi deveśa paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me tatvaṃ padaṃ parañcaiva vidustatve yathā sthitam śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchitam anakṣaramanuccāryamavyayaṃ vṛttalakṣaṇam bindubhūtasthito yasmāt śivasya paramātmanaḥ vidyātatvopari śrīmān saṃkrāntirdvādaśairyutam kālasaṃkhyārthaṃ deveśi dīpyate bhuvicāṃbare sa dehastantu boddhavya svagataṃ dṛḍhagocaram sarvabhūtaṃ hṛdistho'sau jvalatpāvakavarcasam hṛsvastu dahate dhyānadīrghastu mokṣado bhavet

viśatāt bindurūpācca viśeṣānalavigrahaḥ vidante yena tattvāṃśca dehamadhye vyavasthitān layaṃ gamayate yasmāt tasmādbinduriti smṛtaḥ sṛjan saṃharate viśvaṃ sadāśiva niyogataḥ kṣobhakassarvabhūtānāṃ tārakā iva candramāḥ tārakācalitākāraṃ bindudevasya rūpakam someva saumyatā yadvat karṇikāyāṃ samāsataḥ netramadhye bhavedātmā chāyājīvasya dṛśyate kṣetrajñaḥ sa ca vai viṣṇuḥ puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ catuṣkasṛṅkalātītaṃ binduṃ jñātvā śivaṃ vrajet ākāro brahmaṇo rūpaṃ sātvikaṃ paricakṣate ūkāraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpaṃ rājasaṃ tatpracakṣate makāraṃ rudrarūpantu tāmasaṃ parikīrtitam sa binduriti vijñeyo yatrātmā dṛśyate sthitaḥ dṛṣṭvā'ntaṃ sarvabhūtātmā sa śāntapadadīpakam atha * * * * * * devā vinyasya suvṛte ākāraḥ śuklavarṇastu brahmā satvaguṇe sthitaḥ kṛṣṇantu rudraviṣayaṃ tāmasaṃ tatpracakṣate sa binduriti mantavyo yatrātmā dṛśyate sthitaḥ sa niṣkalo parādhyātmaṃ paraṃ brahmamidaṃ smṛtam bindudevasya tatsthānaṃ parātparataraṃ mahat yasmiṃśca līyate bhūyaḥ tadbinduriti saṃjñitam mantrājalājyasaṃyogāt tadbinduriti saṃjñitam pratiṣṭhā sṛṣṭirabhavat śāntisthaḥ sakaleraṇaḥ dhvanimadhyagatastāraḥ tāramadhyagataśśivaḥ

nityāste nirvikāriṇyo nivṛttistena cocyate tiṣṭhatyalakṣitaguṇā pratiṣṭhā tūcyate tataḥ yasmādvedayate tasmādvidyeti vihitā kalā na lipyate susūkṣmatvāt tasmācchāntirihocyate sadāśivākhyamityasmin nāmāni parigīyate yattacchivākhyamākhyātaṃ tattvamapratimaujasam dṛśyate naśyate caiva sthūlaṃ binduriti smṛtam harikuṅkumasaṅkāśo madhyamo bindurucyate śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśo binduḥ jñeyaḥ parāparaḥ daśarūpañca boddhavya sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ param pītaṃ raktañca pītañca kapilo dhūmrameva ca sarvagrahavināśāya nīlaṃ vai parikīrtitam śvetādīnāntu sarveṣāṃ devatāḥ saṃpracakṣate kālāgnirudro navamo daśamastu sadāśivaḥ boddhavyaṃ sādhakaiḥ prājñaiḥ munibhiḥ mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ atastṛtīyamevāhuḥ tatvārthaṃ gahanaṃ padam saptamaṃ śūnyataraṃ syāt śūnyābhāsantathāṣṭamam sukāntaikādaśaḥ prokto dvādaśassuśivaḥ smṛtaḥ daśapañca varābhāsa dhruvo binduśca ṣoḍaśa avyayastu śivo yastu evamaṣṭādaśa kramāt niśreṇyāttvekamūlena ārohetparamaṃ padam śūnyācchūnyataraṃ śūnyamuktamaṣṭādaśa kramāt netrāśritā tu yācchāyā bhruvormadhye vinirgatā śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchritam eka eva yadā devi bindurityabhiśabditam

varṇahīnaṃ na kiñcitsyāt kūṭasthastena cocyate prakṛtyā jālagahanaṃ sarvamutpādya gacchati tasmādanyaistu saṃyuktamuccaretsarvakarmasu binduyuktena kartavyaṃ sarvakarmaprasiddhaye pṛthivyādi vibhāgena jñātavyantu varānane śataṃ śatañca hotavyaṃ tatvaṃ tatvena sandhayet ekabījena hotavyaṃ sarvādhvānamaśeṣataḥ saplutoccārayodvarṇaṃ binduyuktañca kārayet tasyānte tu punardevī pūrṇāhutyastu pātayet netrāśritā tu yācchāyā tasyā lakṣaṃ vadāmyaham anyaśāstre tu yatproktaṃ tatsarvaṃ parikīrtitam bindu bindviti deveśi vadante sarvayoginaḥ khaḍgasyābhimukhenaiva vimārgapravahena tu mukhamāvṛtya tiṣṭheta lākṣāvarṇasamopamaḥ nirdhūmāṅgārasadṛśaṃ piṇḍīkṛtamiva sthitam dvādaśārdhena māsena vyādhibhiśca na pīḍyate kurute nātra sandehaḥ śivatejopavṛṃhitaḥ jāyate sarvakāmitvaṃ uddeśyaṃ tridaśairapi trailokye yatpravarteta pratyakṣaṃ tasya jāyate sṛjan saṃharate viśvaṃ śivavatsvecchatāṃ vrajet tathā te kathayiṣyāmi adhunā śṛṇu cānyathā jñātavyaṃ viditaṃ taiśca śaktilakṣaṃ suśobhane lakṣāśītamahālakṣaṃ drutalohathakālavit pratyakṣasya pravakṣyāmi yogasadbhāvamuttamam prasṛtā sarvamaṅgulya ekāṃ tatra samutsṛjet

tasminnagre tu saṃsthāpya abhyāsādapakarṣayet śanaiśśanaistu tallakṣamākarṣenmukhasaṃmukham suśītalamukhasparśaṃ anaupamyamanuttamam medhākāntisamāyukto māsamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ śaktivatsarvagāmitvaṃ bhavate sādhakeśvare sārvaśāstrasya vettā'sau vāgīśeva na saṃśayaḥ divyadṛṣṭyā tu yā siddhirasya saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu lakṣayīta mahālakṣaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam agnivajjvalate yogī jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ agnivat jvalate sarvaṃ dusparśaṃ tridaśairapi brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ naivalipyeta yogavit pratyakṣe śuklapītāni nīlakṛṣṇasitāni ca sutreṇaiva maṇiryadvadvedhitaḥ bhrājate śubhe eṣa te tattvasadbhāvaṃ tava devi udāhṛtam tasya maṇḍalamadhye tu lalāṭasyopari sthitaḥ dhūmravarṇantu deveśi anekakiraṇojvalam māsamātreṇa yogīndro yāṃ diśāmavalokayet sravantañcintayedbinduṃ turyacāreṇa yoginaḥ etanmṛtyuñjayārthāya dhyātavyaṃ yogibhissadā vividhena varārohe sarvasiddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ dūraśravaṇavijñānaṃ mananañcāvalokanam pūrvoktā yāni rūpāṇi sarvāṇyasmin pratiṣṭhitā siddhayaḥ santi sarvatra tattvālokeṣu suvṛte durvidagdhe śaṭhe krūre anyāyapathavartine śivavartmanyate yastu ācāryaṃ tatvapāragam

tasya deyamidaṃ jñānaṃ anyathā na kadācana kathayasva yathā nyāyaṃ kalādhvānaṃ mama prabho nivṛtyā ca yathā sṛṣṭiḥ pratiṣṭhāyā yathā bhavet śāntyatītañca deveśi kathayāmi samāsataḥ prakṛtyante tu deveśi tasya sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā pratiṣṭhāyāstu hotavyaṃ dīkṣākāle maheśvarī vidyāyā homayenmantrī dīkṣākāle śivādhvare śāntyatītena deveśi dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ kramāt hrasvahaṃso nivṛttiḥ syāt pratiṣṭhā dīrghabheditā visargeṇa samāyuktā śānti vai parikīrtitā ardhendunādasaṃyuktamūkāreṇa samanvitam tena pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt śivasāyujyamicchatām pratiṣṭhāyāntu saptaiva hotavyāni samāhitaiḥ upariṣṭhācchivaṃ tatvaṃ śāntyāyāṃ samudāhṛtam evaṃ jñātvā tu mucyeta mocayecca na saṃśayaḥ bindubhiḥ dyutinādena sa nādaḥ kena bhidyate mṛṇālatantusūtrābhaṃ nādaśūnyena bhidyate tasyāhaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathaṃ sakala niṣkalam kathayasva mehaśāna bhedaṃ tasya parāparam tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi bindudevasya śobhane sthitaḥ saṃhāratatve'smin vyaktarūpaṃ svayaṃ bhuvaḥ tadatītaṃ punardevi niṣkalaṃ kathitaṃ tava etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi ijyate guṇamāhātmyāt sarvatatvādito mahān napuṃsakaiḥ saha jñeya akṣarantu tripañcakam

sa śivaḥ sakalo jñeyaḥ sa śivaḥ sṛjate kalām bindu vijṛmbhate granthyā tataḥ śabdasamudbhavaḥ śaktyaṃbunā'bhiṣiktastu bindutejoṅkuro mahān tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvari nādamadhyāvasāno'sau notpattipralayātmakaḥ na kṣīyate na cālpo'pi na nindyo vardhate kvacit vāyuvadbhramate nityaṃ mūrtibhirdaśabhistathā sa eṣa bhagavān bindussarvalokajagadguruḥ saptārṇavāvaśeṣoka dvādaśārkanipātanaḥ ihaikāṇḍaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ mṛtpiṇḍamiva saṃsthitam cibukārdhārdhakakṣeva maṇivattulayecchivaḥ sa kālassa ca vai mṛtyussa indro varuṇaśśaśī sa brahmā sa ca vai viṣṇu rudra īśvara eva ca prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca vedaṃ sāṃkhyañca yogañca bauddhamārhataṃ tathā sarvaṃ bindumayaṃ jñeyaṃ cittaṃ caitanyamākṛtiḥ aprameyaśca sūkṣmaśca avyaktaśca sanātanaḥ śivabhāvitadharmāṇāṃ bindudevassadātmakaḥ līnāṃśanātmayogena tadā sā niṣkalasmṛtaḥ sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena dviprakāraṃ prakīrtitam kathaṃ śarīre jñātavyaṃ tatvataḥ kathayasva me tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi nādajñānamanuttamam prakṛtistatra saṃbhūtā mahājālaparicchadā puruṣastatra sañjāto guṇātīto nirañjanaḥ tasmin rudrassamutpannaḥ prabhustrailokyanāyakaḥ

kopipradaṇḍapratīkāśā jyotsnākaramiva sthitaḥ yo'sau siddhaḥ śivassūkṣmaḥ suśāntassarvatomukhaḥ layasthānantu tattvajñaiḥ sa eva parikīrtitaḥ jñātvaivaṃ mucyate jñānī bhuñjāno viṣayānapi ko'sau nādaḥ kiṃ pramāṇaḥ kiṃ rūpaḥ kṣaritaḥ kutaḥ mamaiṣā paramā mūrtiḥ nādasaṃjñā varānane nāsya pramāṇaṃ vyāpitvānmukteḥ samupalabhyate yathā saṃvetyanuccārya śabdākṣaravivarjitam aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ chādayitvā sādhakaśravaṇāvubhau asya saṃśravaṇāddevi nādasyāyatalocane mamātmīyamidaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śarīraṃ nādasaṃjñitam tataḥ parataradhyeyaṃ yo'nyaḥ pratyupadiśyate parametasya vīryaṃ yat anuccāryamanāmayam eṣa te kathitaḥ samyak nādaḥ paramadurlabhaḥ padametadatikramya caturthaṃ turyasaṃjñitam taccācalamanirdeśyamanantamajamavyayam niṣprapañcamanasvāntamatīndriyamanāmayam niṣtūyaṃ vimalaṃ vṛttamuttuṅgavyāpinaddhruvam jagadbījamidaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paramākāśamavyayam padametīcchāntilayaṃ gatohyatrāpi saṃkhyayaḥ tataste śabdatanavoścakravarti pade sthitāḥ te'dhikāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kālasyāsya parivyayāt kimanyā kāraṇe śaktiḥ ananyā vā prakīrtitā yadi nānyā bhavecchaktiḥ tayorbrūhi yadantaram ananyānyatvabhāvena astināstīti saṃśayaḥ

tasmānnissaṃśayo brūhi agopyaṃ parameśvara sarvajñā cetanā śuddhā sarvatatvaprakāśikā guṇato doṣataścaiva śuddhāśuddheṣu prāṇiṣu sarveṣvanugatā śaktiḥ nityaṃ sarveṣu tiṣṭhati a * * nātve ṣaṭ vartante'tha ceśvaraśaktayaḥ ākāśe cāvakāśitvaṃ tattvadīśvaraśaktayaḥ sparśo'nileṃvare śabdastadvadīśvaraśaktayaḥ śaktiśaktimatostadvadanāditvamiheṣyate tejo lokā svadehasthāstathā śakti pare śive dharmiṇaḥ svecchayā dharmaṃ pravṛttimadhitiṣṭhati dhṛte dharmiṇi dharmo'sau satkāraṇamihocyate kathayasva aśeṣantu tatvabhedaṃ parāparam kathañca śayane tatvā vidante svapnavāriṇaḥ śvasane kasthitāstatvā dīrghaprāṇe care sthitāḥ nṛtyato gāyataścaiva manyudaḥ karuṇotsuke eṣa karmasu saktānāṃ prāṇatyāgeṣu kā gatiḥ vijñāyante kathaṃ tatvā aṣṭadhā navadhā sthitāḥ antaḥkaraṇahīnāśca yathā dehe pratiṣṭhitāḥ śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ dehe tatvā yathā sthitāḥ śrūyatāṃ jñānasadbhāvaṃ tatvabhedaṃ parāparam harṣonmādaśca saṃmohaḥ kathitaṃ surasundarī ūrdhvedharonubhāvaśca vāmadakṣiṇatastathā vāgvaktrādharanikṣiptamanimittanirīkṣaṇam evaṃ vai aṣṭadhā jñātvā etadvai śūnyalakṣaṇam huṃkāramanasaṃyuktiḥ kalāḍhyaḥ kathito'ṣṭadhā

manyukāruṇyasaṃyuktaṃ mukhasaṃsthamupalakṣayet analānilavikṣiptaṃ geyaṃ jhaṅkārasaṃyutam āghūrmitaṃ vighūrmitaṃ suṣuptaṃ suptalakṣayet kṣayāntasya guṇāhyete jñātavyāstatvacintakaiḥ huṃkāraṃ jarjharavākyañca kaṇṭhoṣṭhaye nigamāṣṭakam udāne sakalo devo vyākule niṣkalaṃ param rahasye tu kalāsāraṃ vikrameva malaṃ smṛtam kṣayamantaṃ varārohe unmāde cāvadhāraya ūrdhvaṃ sakalasaṃyogaṃ niṣkalaṃ dhārakaṃpitam vāme kaleśvaraṃ tatvaṃ dakṣiṇe bhujamālinam kṣayamantaṃ varārohe niṣkalo dehalakṣitaḥ sakalaṃ vaktramārge tu vāmamārge tu niṣkalam animitte kalāḍhyastu nirīkṣe khamalasmṛtaḥ hṛdgatakṣayamantastha udbhāse kathayāmi te trividhena tu vijñeyaṃ jñānabhede malāṣṭakam hṛdyātā sakalo devo niṣkalasyādalakṣitaḥ kalāḍhyo bhāsite vidyāt khamale śvāsakaṃpite kṣapitantu varārohe huṃkṛtena tu lakṣayet caturthaṃ bhedametattu kathitaṃ surasundarī galānantapadaṃ vidyāt hāsye śūnyārtha lakṣitam kaṃpite kṣapaṇaṃ proktaṃ kathitantvanupūrvaśaḥ pañcamaṃ bhedametaddhi kathitaṃ tvanupūrvaśaḥ vyāpite śūnyamityāhuḥ eṣa te bhujamālinam pṛthak bhāvassadā hyete boddhavyāstvaparājite jhaṅkārasvarasaṃyuktaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhyaṃ surasundarī

aghūrmite kalādhāraṃ vighūrme niṣkalātmakam svapne tu kalanātkālaṃ svapnānte khamalaṃ smṛtam kaṇṭhoṣṭhyantu vibodhe tu subhedaḥ saptamaḥ kramāt śīghraṃ śūnyaṃ vijānīyāt svagatamupalakṣayet huṃkāre kṣapaṇo devaḥ sarvametadvipārayet vākye sthūlapade śubhre kaṇṭhoṣṭhyaḥ sarvatasthitaḥ tatvaṃ vijñāyate samyak vidhipūrveṇa niṣkalam haṃsākhye bindunādañca ardhacandre nirodhikā akṣare cākṣaraṃ sarvaṃ boddhavyamanupūrvaśaḥ evaṃ vai hyaṣṭadhā bhedaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tava śobhane vākyasthaṃ hṛdayasthantu dadāne vaiva saṃsthitam śivañcānugataṃ vidyā vidyārājñāntu vikramaḥ apākaprabhavaṃ divyaṃ nābhikarṇāntavarjitam karṇanābhyantare tāluṃ padmanālānukuñcitam ubhau tau tatkṣipattatvaṃ śāntattvaṃ sakalaissaha ūrdhvavāhamanau gāraṃ prasphurantaṃ samāsataḥ hṛtpadmenābhideśantu karṇatālukamadhyayoḥ udāne niścalasthāne sarvasthāne sulocane etacchabdāṣṭakaṃ devi hitāya samudāhṛtam anādinidhanābhāvadurlakṣaṃ śūnyabhāvanā tenedaṃ jñātaṃ suśroṇiryasya bhāvena matsthitiḥ abhāvasya parityāgī bhāvopagatacetasaḥ śrutismṛtyartha vākyaiśca kāvyālaṅkāraśobhanaiḥ abhāvaśśūnyatāṃ yāti śūnyañcābhāva ucyate abhāvena sadā śūnye mano niścalatāṃ gatam

yoginaśca tathā cānye kupatheṣvapi ye sthitāḥ te'pi cātra bruvantyaiva gatiratra kuto'nyataḥ evaṃ me saṃśayo deva yatsatyaṃ tadbravīhi me mātṛkā śivarūpeṇa buddhisaṃbhavapādapam mama bījodbhavāssarve tava yonivinirgatāḥ saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtañcaiva apabhraṃśānunāsikam tvaṃ sadā darpiṇī devī ahaṃkāraratā sadā avikāraṃ tato loko madvikāramapāsitam bhuñjatāṃ ṣaḍrasāhāraṃ mriyante sarvajantavaḥ mṛtpiṇḍeṣu ghaṭo yadvat tantuṣveva paṭo yathā mūlajñānaṃ japitvā tu yuktā dhyāyanti yoginaḥ pravṛjya labhyate mokṣaścaryayātha maheśvara jñānena labhyate deva tat jñānasya prakāśakaḥ tanmamācakṣva deveśa atra me saṃśayo mahān kṣapaṇāccaiva dehasya mokṣamicchantyabuddhayaḥ kṣutpipāsī tathā varṣī mokṣārthī subudhassahet netadvai jananaṃ vākyaṃ jagadvyāptiṃ na muktaye mokṣo bhavati jñānena dehī nirmuktakevalam vinītarathamārūḍharacakṣuriva sārathiḥ pañcarātrivido ye tu anyaiḥ pāpādukaissaha agniragnau yathā kṣiptaṃ toye toyamivārpitam nirvāṇassa tu vijñeyaḥ sukhaduḥkhavivarjitam sarve kliṣṭāstathātyantaṃ mokṣatatvamajānataḥ jīvanāśo bhavedyatra nissukhaṃ niṣpracetanam teṣāṃ māyodaro mokṣassa caitanyamavasthayā

avamānena mokṣeṇa cetanārahitena tu asmin śaive mahājñāne vijñānanagare śubhe ! patibhāvasamatvaṃ vai bhavate jñāninaḥ sa tu duḥkhānāmāgamo nāsti sukhaṃ tatra nirantaram cetanābhāvayormuktiḥ na tu saṃmohamocitāḥ śivo nirañjano bhūtvā tiṣṭhate rāgavarjitaḥ aśarīrī śarīrī vā svecchayā ca bhavatyasau aiśvaryaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhuñjate ca yathā sukham śivajñānaṃ paraṃ prāpya nirguṇaṃ sarvakāmikam sarvaṃ vyāpya pratiṣṭhante sarvabhūteṣvavasthitāḥ aprāpya sarvalokeṣu nā gatiśca kadācana prakṛterye vikārāstu nirguṇaṃ guṇameva ca ye caiśvaryaguṇāssarve śive tiṣṭhanti śāśvate aprameyabalopetassarvajñaḥ khalu sarvadaḥ dūrācchravaṇavijñānamananañcāvalokanam svādhīnassarvakāryeṣu pravṛtte balisūdanaḥ damanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ manaśconmana eva ca ajaraścāmaraścaiva akṣayaḥ kṣobhakārakaḥ ajñānasaṃbhavāhyete sukhañcaikañca kevalam sa śāntasamaye prāpte na bhūyo viśate'raṇim samyak jñānaṃ viditvā tu paśutvaṃ na bhavetpunaḥ viditvā śāstrasadbhāvaṃ mṛtyuduḥkhaiśca pīḍyate apratyakṣā gatirdeva brūhi me parameśvara sa śūlo vāyuvegena dakṣiṇastanakopari hrasvadīrghaplutañcaiva sādhāritasakauśakam

aṣṭābhenaiva saṃyuktatantriṇī amṛtaṃ smṛtam laukikāsteṣu vijñeyā śivatīrthyānu me śṛṇu abhijiccaiva nakṣatraṃ tasyopari jayantikā dhruvatārāgaṇajyotsnā cakravatparilelihet tadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ yāti pūrṇābde tu na saṃśayaḥ dānaṃ japaṃ tato dhyānaṃ tatsarvaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet yatkiñcitkurute karma tatsarvaṃ mokṣasiddhidam jñātvā vāraṃ tithiñcaiva tatsarvaṃ siddhimokṣadam amṛtena tu saṃyuktaṃ ābhyāṃtvekena mokṣadam evaṃ vai yo vijānāti rahasyamidamuttamam mṛtaṃ kāyaṃ na śīryeta etatpratyayamuttamam yajanti viprā yajñaistu mūrtyaṣṭakasaṃyutāḥ te'pi kasmānna mucyanti mantraistaireva dīkṣitāḥ varṇairevacitā vedāste'pi kasmānna muktidāḥ śatārdhākṣaravinyāsaṃ puruṣaṃ binduvigraham vṛkṣagulmalatānāntu oṣadhīnāṃ sa saṃbhavaḥ yakārākṣaramityeke prāṇādyā viśvatomukham rakāramanalañcātra prapadanti vipaścitaḥ annapānendhano bhoktā sa jīvātmeti cocyate vibhūriti imaṃ prāhuḥ tacchakramavapūjitam amṛtasyandakundābhaṃ candrāṃśusamaśītalam athāhurapare kecidvyomabījamanuttamam kecidāhurayaṃ śreṣṭha śatārdhārdhaṃ vyavasthitam traividya vṛddhāstadvanti puruṣaṃ dvādaśākṣaram sakalontakamādityaṃ yatpurastātprakāśate

ṛgvedāhavanīyo'gniḥ sātviko guṇa ucyate ukāro viṣṇudevatyaṃ rājasaṃ dravalakṣaṇam svapnontarātmā ityevaṃ vadanti paramaṃ padam sāma vai gārhapatyāgnistāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam hakāramamātro vai turyaṃ tatparamaṃ padam guṇātītaḥ paraṃ śāntiṃ yajjñātvā'mṛtamaśnute turyātītaṃ paraṃ brahma padaṃ * * sadātmakam ālayaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ vidyālayamiti smṛtam daśa lakṣeśvaraṃ kecit tārakaṃ jñānamāśritāḥ śatārdhabījasaṃhāraṃ kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ matam sa eva pañcadhāvasthaḥ śivaḥ sakalaniṣkalaḥ bhujaṅgakuṭilākāraṃ anuccāryamanāmayam ityañjalinamaskāra japadhyānavivarjitam niyuktamanasaṅkalpa sa eṣa paramaṃ padam pañcadhā pañca daivatyaṃ praṇavaṃ parikīrtitam ardhamātrārdhasaṃsthañca pañcadhā vigrahī śivaḥ jñānapādena saṃmūḍhāḥ niścayaṃ nādhigacchataḥ ṛca eva mantravyāpitvaṃ navijānanti mohitāḥ sthūlabhāvasuvṛṣṭātmā paśujñānaratā narāḥ duṣyanti parapakṣāṇi svapakṣapariniṣṭhitāḥ paratattvamajānantaḥ sthūlajñānaphalepsavaḥ aniścitamatāssarve vivadanti parasparam kimarthaṃ sṛṣṭimīśānaḥ kurute sā pradhānajam prādhānikaṃ śarīraṃ vā kiṃ vidhaṃ pāramārthikam pradhānapuruṣeśānāṃ kartṛtvaṃ kasya kīdṛśam

kimarthaṃ bandhanaṃ vā'pi ko vā bandhaḥ sureśvara kiṃ prakṛtyā saha paśuḥ yujyate sa viyujyate sa guṇannirguṇañcaiva yogabhedañca tatvataḥ devyanādibhavā paṅkte sannimagnāśśarīriṇaḥ kathitaṃ tava deveśi pradhānaguṇamuttamam adhovṛttiratṛptātmā guṇabhuk pāśagocaraḥ asarvavidasaṃpūrṇa udāsīnaḥ pumān smṛtaḥ nirguṇassarvavitkartā svatantrassarvagocarataḥ budhyamānaḥ samākhyātaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ parameśvarī ananto niścalaścaiva nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ anādireko niṣkaṃpaḥ cetano sarvabhṛcchivaḥ pradhānameka sarvatra kṣetrasaṃjñamacetanam acetanatvādavyakto na svayaṃ saṃpravartate anayorbhāvayoryogaṃ saṃmohakaraṇaṃ mahat cetanācetanatvañca dvāvapyetāvanīśvarau īśvarastadadhiṣṭhāya pradhānapuruṣadvayam nāmārthamīkṣya kurute sṛṣṭimīśaḥ pradhānajāḥ sahajairañjitaḥ pāśaiḥ kevalopyavaśaḥ paśuḥ sadasmādaprabuddhatvāt avyaktaguṇasaṃśrayāt śaktopyanugrahaṃ kartuṃ kevalasyeśvaraḥ paśoḥ yasmātkāraṇahīnatvānnavetti puruṣātmani avyaktamāhuḥ karaṇaṃ kāryañca daśa lakṣaṇam tatra vijñānamātrantu puruṣārthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ tatvajñānāddhi niśśeṣaṃ kṣayamāyāti bandhanam saṃsāravinivṛttasya puruṣasyāpi na cyutiḥ

prāṇināmanukaṃpārthamadbhutaṃ saṃprakāśyate svasaṃvedyamasaṃvedyamavyaktaṃ gamyate'rthataḥ bhūtaprasūti nānātvamekatvañca nigadyate tatsarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ proktaṃ tatvavidbhiranekaśaḥ śuddhāśuddhaṃ na gīyante nātmarūpa svabhāvataḥ śuddhāni ca nibadhnanti ajñāniṣu śarīriṣu tatvāni śubharūpāṇi nibadhnanti śarīriṇām tatprākṛtamasaṃdigdhaṃ arthavidbhirudāhṛtam śūnyamicchanti bahavaḥ paramātmānamavyayam prapadanti paraṃ brahma bodhayanti parasparam na samyagupacārārthamuktanna paramārthataḥ śūnyādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ ṛṣibhiḥ parikalpitāḥ tatparāparabhedena gīyate dvividhaḥ punaḥ śabdatanmātramudbhūtaṃ tadādiparamaṃ padam māyānigūḍhaparamaṃ paramāyāvivarjitam sahajairañjitaiḥ pāśaiḥ śūnyamavyaktarūpiṇam yadetamabhisaṃkhyātamākāśamajamavyayam śabdāccakāyasaṃsiddhiḥ heturākāśalakṣaṇam vidyā dehaṃ karotīti puruṣāvyaktavedanam jñānarūpo'pi vargārthaṃ viparīta * māśrayam yataśśabdaguṇaṃ śūnyaṃ bodhayatyeṣa mohinām mantrātmakaṃ jagadidaṃ mantraśabdamayaṃ smṛtam tasmādutpannamātrastu mantrānilasamīritāḥ śūnyādyacchandarūpantu uddiṣṭamamitaujasam evamanyonyavitathā bhūtāni svaguṇaissaha

sthūlabhāvena mahatā sūkṣmeṇa ca samantataḥ sarvatattvamayohyeṣa samabhāvamayastathā sthito yassarvajaṃ jñānameṣa piṇḍaḥ pratāpavān pañcabhūtātmakaṃ piṇḍamidamavyaktasaṃjñikam saptakoṭimahātantra noktaṃ pūrvaṃ hi me vada budhyamānasya vedasya yathātathye vā me vada pauruṣaṃ gīyate tatvamabhavaṃ bhavagocaram krīḍate'vyaktasaṃyogāt bālakrīḍanakairiva vyaktamavyametena tenāpyetatsamāvṛtam pauruṣe vyaktajairbhāvaissahātmīyairivā vyayaḥ vadanti jātamityevaṃ kṛtañcākṛtabuddhayaḥ anyo'tra duḥkhanirmuktaḥ prabhustiṣṭhatyalakṣitaḥ tridhā rūpaḥ paśurayaṃ bhavatyekopyanindite aprabuddhastadā proktaḥ tatvavidbhirayaṃ paśuḥ nityabuddhaḥ pradhāneśa puruṣādhīśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ tataḥ pravartate rāgastatsaṃgādaśubhaṃ paśoḥ tatprasaktassatānyeva vicarantyatra cintayā abhibhūya balaṃ kārśnyaṃ anivāryaḥ pravartate pravartate vimūḍhasya buddhināśastu dehinaḥ ajñānasaṃgātpuruṣoḥ prayātyavyaktasaṃśrayam pravartate mohasaṃgāt nirguṇasyāpi dehinaḥ prayātyūrdhvamadhaścaiva ghaṭayantravadacyutaḥ balavān gīyate pāpaiḥ ko'tra duḥkhāni kasyacit bālayauvanavṛddhādirūpāṇyetāni kasya vā ko vā gṛhaṃ samutsṛjya śarīrāṇyapagacchati

etāni kathayiṣyāmi māyayāpahṛtaḥ pumān vyādhijanmajarāmṛtyu duḥkhāyā saparicchadaḥ evamavyaktajairbhāvaiḥ guṇairapyanurañjitaḥ jāyate vardhate caiva duḥkhāyā sa paricchadaḥ etadapratibandhasya puruṣasya guṇāntaram ajñatvamasya sahajaṃ īśānugrahacodanāt tatprasaṅgādayaṃ dhīmān mahānidrāgatavyathaḥ uṣṇodakasusaṃpūrṇamāśāpāśormisaṃkulam icchādveṣādikaluṣaṃ samano'yaśītalam yonyāvartasamākīrṇaṃ māyāniviḍakardamam sukhaduḥkhabhayaṃ kāle velāparicchadam raktamāṃsakaphāśśuklaṃ kramādannātpravartate tadannaṃ piṇḍakabalaiḥ grāsairaktantu dehibhiḥ bhuktapītatadāhāraṃ atastatkurute dvidhā agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpya tadannañca jalopari vāyunā dhāmyamāno'gniratyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalam dvidhā bhavati tatpakvaṃ pṛthakkiṭṭaṃ pṛthagrasam malāśrayāḥ kaphasvedaviṇmūtrā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ tāsāṃ mukhe punassūkṣmaṃ prāṇasthāpayate rasam pratarpayati saṃpūrṇāstāsvadehaṃ samantataḥ pacyate pacyamānañca bhavetpākadvayaṃ punaḥ raktalomāni māṃsañca keśamedastathaiva ca etadannātsamudbhūtaṃ śuklañca prasavātmakam ṛtukāle yadā śuklaṃ nirdoṣaṃ yonisaṃsthitam visargakāle śuklasya jīvaḥkāraṇasaṃyutaḥ

sa tatraiva ratiṃ yāti prāk tanenoparañjitaḥ taccittaḥ tanmayo bhūtvā bhuṅkte bhogān bubhukṣitaḥ saṃsṛtaḥ praviśedyonau karmabhinnairniyāmataḥ pañcarātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudākāratāṃ vrajet dvisaptāhādbhavetpeśyādraktamāṃsaṃ tadā dṛḍham punaśca māsamātreṇa pañcadhā jāyate tu saḥ māsadvayena sarvāṇi tamasassaṃbhavanti hi māsaiścaturbhiraṅgulya prajāyante yathākramam dantapaṅktistathā jihvā jāyante tu nakhādayaḥ vāyurmeḍhramupasthañca nābhiścaiva prajāyate aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃpūrṇaṃ śiraḥ keśasamanvitam pañca pañcārthasaṃyuktaḥ paripakvassa tiṣṭhati nābhimūlanibandhena vardhate sa dine dine sukhaduḥkhaṃ vijānāti nidrāsvapnaṃ purākṛtam nānāyoni sahasrāṇi mayā dṛṣṭāni jāyatā tatra śreyaḥ kariṣyāmi yena garbho na saṃbhavet adhyeṣyāmi śivajñānaṃ saṃsāravinivartakam jīvaḥ karmavaśādāste mokṣopāyamacintayan tathā jarāyuṣā dehī duḥkhī tiṣṭhati veṣṭitaḥ garbhodakena siktāṅgaḥ tathānte vyākulaḥ pumān garbhakuṃbhe tathā kṣiptaḥ pacyate jāṭharāgninā yadduḥkhamupajāyeta garbhehyeṣa guṇaṃ bhavet dehena duḥkhabahulaṃ sughoramiti saṃkulam caraskarāṇāṃ satyānāṃ garbhe duḥkhaṃ mahatsmṛtam mūrchā ca jāyate tīvrā jāyamānasya dehinaḥ

śarīraṃ sthūlasūkṣmāṇi dṛśyādṛśyābhiranvitam prasvedamaśuciryāti rantasthaṃ sravate bahiḥ aviśuddhaṃ viśuddhasya karmabhistasya nirmitam bālye ca duḥkhamajñānāt kaumāre guruśāsanāt kṛṣivāṇijyasevādi gorakṣādyaiśca karmabhiḥ maraṇe ca mahadduḥkhaṃ prārthanāyāṃ tato'dhikam arthasyārjanarakṣā vā duḥkhannāśe vyaye punaḥ akārye saṃpravṛttiśca duḥkhaṃ vaitīndhane sadā antarbahiḥ prakopaśca duḥkhaṃ rājye mahībhṛtām anyonyamahimā caivānyonyasyāpi bhakṣaṇam chinnabhinnopi śastraiśca vyādhibhiśca prapīḍitāḥ gātraṃ svaṃ bhinnamapyastrairvikalañcendriyairapi rāgañca rañjakaṃ kasya viṣayānandalakṣaṇam nauṣadhīrna dhanādānaṃ na mātā na ca bāndhavāḥ (sādhayāntaṃ tapo japyaṃ yogasiddhirmahātmabhiḥ susādhana tapojapyaiḥ yogasiddhairmahātmabhiḥ hātātamātahā kānte krandatyevaṃ suduḥkhitaiḥ bāndhavaistu pariṣvaktaḥ priyaiśca parivāritaḥ caturante ca khaḍvāyāṃ parivṛtya muhurmuhuḥ khaṭvāttu vāñchite bhūmiṃ bhūmeḥ khaṭvāṃ punarmahīm yācamānaśca salilaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukam pañcāṅgaiḥ khinnamānaśca kālapāśena karpitaḥ jīvastṛṇajadūkeva dehāddehāṃ viśetkramāt nānāvyādhisamākīrṇe viṣayoragabhūṣite kāmakrodhabhavaistāpaiḥ muhurmuhuratāpitaḥ

cintāśokasusaṃpūrṇe aho devi suduḥkhitaḥ viṇmūtraretassaṃpūrṇe kathamatra ramāmyaham anarthāni manojñāni tadvadetaccharīrakam tatvagrāhasamākīrṇe plavodajñānasāgare suciraṃ dīrghaniśvāsamutsṛjya parivedya ca putrāgārādikaiśvarya vyākulīkṛtamānasaḥ tvacārthāḥ tva ca mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ tva gṛhāṇi vai putradārakuṭuṃbārthāḥ śatṛvatpratibhānti me tasyānusadṛśaṃ bhuṅkte phalameko'nyajanmani eṣāmāśritya bhogāya kalpitāstena duḥkhitāḥ sahāyā na bhavantyete nānugacchanti gacchatām ekaḥ sukṛtamaśnāti tathā duṣkṛtameva ca vairāgyamaparamāsthāya mṛgayatyātmano gatim santariṣye sukhenāhamacirādaśubhārṇavam naurivottāraṇāyedaṃ saṃsārāṃbhonidhe smṛtaḥ tadasyāpyupabhogena kṣayamāyātyaśeṣataḥ karmataḥ svargato yasmāt tasmādāvartanaṃ punaḥ saṃpradṛṣṭā gatiriyaṃ sarve te kṣayadharmiṇaḥ * * * * * bahavaḥ kṣayamatra viśāradāḥ sanyastamapyavijñānādupa * * * * * * vairāgyavṛttiraparā jñānavṛttistathā parā guṇalakṣaṇāḥ jñānādapunarāvṛttiḥ bhavettadapi kāriṇī * * * * * * sarvāḥ niṣphalaścāpyaśeṣataḥ sa kāmā kāmitaphalā nyāsayogādilakṣaṇāḥ

* smṛtāḥ karmāṇi vinivedyante sā tu sanyāsikī kriyā yāssamuddiṣṭāścatasrastriguṇātmikāḥ yatkiñcidārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ hiṃsā pū * * * * * śeṣavṛttī guṇamayī tiṣṭhatyekāpyaviplutā svarge vā narake vā'pi yatra yatra yathā tathā * * * kta kriyāraṃbhāssaktāḥ karmaphaleṣiṇam sanyāsaṃ ye prakurvanti kṛtānā * * * * * avyakte vā parikṣīṇe guṇe nāśena vidyate * * * * * * * * yogabhedaṃ samāsataḥ sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena śivena paramātmanā nirguṇaṃ yogaṃ prāpya saguṇena mumukṣavaḥ bhuktvā śātiśayān bhogān ante tatra guṇātmikān vidyāyogena siddhānāṃ duḥkhaṃ sātiśayātmakam tasmāt sātiśayaṃ yogaṃ sa vidyākalpanāyutam adhunā kathayiṣyāmi vidyāyogasya nirṇayam trisareṇubhramo vāyureṇukaḥ parikīrtitaḥ manovasthamaṇuṃ vidyāt vāk sthāne ca aṇudvayam hrasvadīrghapḷtākhyastu mātrātrayamudāhṛtam ekamātraṃ vadeccāṣo dvimātraṃ vāyaso vadet ghaṇṭānādāntasaṃsthantu virāmo yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ hṛdgatenaiva bhāvena anādī nādamavyayam manasā cintayedyāvaddhṛdisthannābhi bhāṣate yadetadakṣarannāma ardhamātrārdhasaṃsthitam sa vidyasya tu yogasya nirṇayaṃ samudāhṛtam

etatpradhānikaṃ sarvaṃ sāṃkhyajñānārthadarśanam bhagavaṃstīvrasaṃsārādajñānāvartasaṃkulāt tvatprasādādahaṃ sarvaṃ vijñānāmṛtamuttamam puruṣāvyaktayorevaṃ antaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā yathā tasya matirdevi jāyate parame pade tatvātītaṃ yadānveṣī guruśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ liṅgahīnetvagamanaṃ tasmāddevi na sidhyati tayā caivendriyātīte tasya naikākṛte pade nīyate ca yadā rūpaṃ gacchate * * * tadā tadā nivartate devi anyathā na nivartate na tatra kathayetkiñcit ko vā pṛcchati sundari saṅkalpañcaiva vācā ca tasmātprājñaḥ parityajet tatraiva tu ratiṃ nityaṃ buddhiḥ prajñā smṛtirmatiḥ śivaṃ śāntaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ yo vai vetti sa śaivavit ye vadanti tato mūḍhāḥ na te śaivasya pāragāḥ bindunādaṃ parityajya mantragrāmamaśeṣataḥ akṣaratvaṃ kutastasya kṣaratve vartate sadā tāvattatsakalo jñeyo niṣkalastu tato'nyathā sarvametadanityantu sa devāsuramānuṣam sikatāsu kutastailaṃ śaśaśṛṅge dhanuḥ kutaḥ sūkṣmo bhinnakalaścaiva śivo jñeyo'tha pañcadhā tṛtīyaṃ bhedamākhyā hi yathā sakalaniṣkalam etatte kathayiṣyāmi pañca bhedātmakaṃ śivam vyomavyāpī paro devaḥ pañcamantro maheśvaraḥ sakalaśceti yaḥ prokta svayaṃ devo hyumāpatiḥ

vyāpayedbhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpayetsarvadehiṣu avikalpasamo bhāvo yatra mantreṇa yujyate sthūlasūkṣmeṣu bhūteṣu sthitassarvaśarīriṇām vyāpitvātsakalo devāḥ kalātatvaṃ prakīrtitam sakalaḥ kurute sṛṣṭiṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayacchati aprameyohyanirdeśyo naupamyo rūpavarjitaḥ dehatatvaparicchinne ninādaḥ sarvadehinām sakalena vinirmukto bindunādavivarjitaḥ vidyāvidyāvinirmuktaṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam manasā mokṣasidhyarthanniṣkale tu layaṃ kuru dṛśya'trārdhavimalaṃ jñeyaṃ sakalaniṣkalam oṃkāraśabdatanmātraṃ śrūyate kathyate na ca sakalaṃ yojayitvā tu niṣkalaṃ yojyate yadā dehasthaḥ sakalo jñeyo niṣkalo dehavarjitaḥ caturthamākāśamayaṃ nādātītamatīndriyam paramāṇususūkṣmatvāt bhāvitavyaṃ nirāmayam paramāṇususūkṣmo'sau hṛdi madhye vyavasthitaḥ mantrākṣarapadairagrairviyasthaṃ paśyate sadā pāpakṣayācca yogācca dhyānasyopacayāttathā sarvāntasthassamādhistha antaḥkaraṇagocaraḥ bhūjalāgnyanilākāśa rājye(ātme)nduravirūpavān akārādi kṣakārāntaṃ rūpaṃ mantrakalātmakam mantrākṣarapadaiḥ yasmāt padārthaiḥ saṃsthitā matiḥ evantu daśadhā jñeyaṃ punarjñeyantu pañcadhā śivassāṅgo'tha gāyatrī sadyādyāḥ pañca cāpare

bhinnāvasthamidaṃ jñātvā yojayetsusamāhitaḥ eṣa te kathito devi pañcavasthaḥ paraśśivaḥ iti niśvāsakārikāyāṃ aṣṭāviṃśati paṭalaḥ tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi sarvajñānādideveśi sarvajñastena socyate sarvagaḥ paripūrṇaśca paritṛptassa ucyate svaśaktyā bodhayedyasmāt tasmādbodhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ sthitināśaśca deveśasvatantrastena socyate yogairavyāhatatvācca aluptastena socyate śakteravyāhatattvācca anantastena socyate mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivaṃ yāti anāmayam tanmamācakṣva deveśa varṇe hīnaṃ yadā bhavet tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yatsurairapi durlabham varṇabhedastu jñātavyaṃ tattvabhedañca tatvataḥ devatāvasthābhedañca pañca bhedāssamāsataḥ tadā tu kathito devi ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥ vāyubhedaṃ punastasya devatāvarṇabhedanam tanmamācakṣva deveśa atra me saṃśayo mahān tadgatastanmayo bhūtvā śṛṇu ekāgramānasā varṇairguptaṃ viluptañca tadyathā kathayāmi te tena devi viluptena pañcamena samanvitaḥ ṣaṣṭhahīnaṃ yadā devi makārastatra dṛśyate yadā tena vihīnastu ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥ na lopena varārohe yasminvakrahalākṛtiḥ saptatatvādi dehe'smin mayā pūrṇamudāhṛtā

pañca tatvā sthitā hyūrdhvamayaścaiva vyavasthitaḥ vāyubhedaṃ punastasya kathyamānamidaṃ śṛṇu udānassaṃsthito hyūrdhve apāno'dho vyavasthitaḥ samānassarvagastatra vyāpī teṣāṃ dhanañjayaḥ tadā tu kathito devi ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥ śaktinādena tu yadā hīnaṃ tairvihīnastu niṣkalaḥ ebhirvarṇairyadā hīnaṃ ṣaḍvarṇarahito bhavet tadāntau paramaṃ śāntaṃ varṇarūpavivarjitam na mano vidyate tatra cintā tatra na vidyate adyāhaṃ deva jānāmi jīvitañca sujīvitam vyañjanasvaranirmuktaṃ varṇarūpavivarjitam gurupāraṃ parāddevi saṃpradāyamivoditam yathā yena ca bhāvena bhāvajñaḥ kathayedguruḥ yathā ca bhāvamābhāve bhāvaṃ bhāvati śobhane tadekaṃ vacanañcintyaṃ yena śreyo'hamāpnuyām jñeyantadvyatiriktānya jñāne jñeyaṃ vidhīyate śuddhā svābhāvikī mūrtiḥ ayatnādeva jāyate viśeṣastu madhukṣīro jalāni amṛtādibhiḥ muktyarthantu praśaṃsanti jñeyaṃ dharmapravedinaḥ rasendreṇaiva lohānāṃ kālikā sparśavedhinā sparśavat jñānamuddiṣṭaṃ agnivajjñeyamiṣyate svakāraṇaguṇāveśāt tanmayatvaṃ prapadyate sveṣu sveṣu tadaiśvarya kāraṇaṃ tulyadharmatām vijñānāttu viśīryeta trividhaṃ bandhanañca yat icchāśaktiguṇā vyāptyā na janturduḥkhabhāk bhavet

śivasya paripūrṇasya adhvānantu kathaṃ bhavet ākāśasya yathā nordhvaṃ na madhyaṃ nāpyadhaḥ kvacit paśubhāvāpadātītya patibhāvena tiṣṭhati unnamatvaṃ śivatvañca prayātītyupacaryate sarvavyāpīti devastu kathyate mama śaṅkara patre puṣpe phale toye yadi sarvatra vidyate sthāvare jaṅgame caiva bījādyeṣu ca sarvataḥ patrapuṣpaphalādīnāṃ yadi tatra na vidyate avyakte vyaktatā nāsti rūpavarṇatvavedinām vyaktarūpaṃ śarīrantu vyaktaṃ vai kṛtakātmakam sarvavyāpī bhaveddevaḥ pūjā dehaḥ praśasyate pratighāte vilakṣantu ākāśaṃ sarvatomukham yadetatprāk samuddiṣṭamākāśamajamavyayam parādhīnamakartāramajñaṃ prasavadharmiṇam vikāriṇaṃ sātiśayaṃ vyaktamavyaktalakṣaṇam eṣa dharmaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ śūnyasyānīśvaratvatā na tathā tu paraṃ tatvaṃ vyāpayantaṃ nivāryate anumānannacopamyaṃ na ca tasyāsti yanmama na śakyaṃ kiñcittasyātha pravaktuṃ guṇalakṣaṇam tadvatsarvagato devassūkṣmatvānnopalabhyate kṣīyate vardhate candra asthiro viṣamaścalaḥ amāyī nirvikārī ca bahirante ca saṃsthitaḥ maline'pi svadehe tu dṛśyate parameśvaraḥ vidyamāno na dṛśyeta tathā patraphalādiṣu upadeśena deveśi pratyakṣaṃ sarvatasthitaḥ

yathā tvaṃ devi saṃmūḍhā asaṃgrāhye vyavasthitāḥ evaṃ patreṣu puṣpeṣu dṛśyate parameśvaraḥ sūkṣmatvātsaṃsthitastatra dṛṣṭvā tannavikalpanā vidyamāno'pi teṣveva sūkṣmatvānna tu vidyate tejogni maṇikāṃsānāṃ ākāśe darśane tathā eṣaṃ patraphalādīnāṃ bījādye prasaveṣu ca sarvataḥ pāṇicaraṇaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham tasmāttanna vikalpeta avicāreṇa śobhate sarvābhāsannirābhāsamarūpasarvarūpakam sarvavyāpi śarīre sve paṭhyate varṇasaṃharau yatasvadehe paṭhito nirodho'sya kutasmṛtaḥ sānnidhyakāraṇañcaiva virodhañca na vidyate vidhisāmagryahetau tu kīrtitā hīnaśāsane nacaitadarthavādastu vidhivādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ aiśvaryamatulaṃ lābhamamaratvañca śāśvatam nahi doṣo viśodho vā ubhayārthaprasiddhidaḥ pradeśinīti vṛttiḥ syānna tu sarvagatā vibhoḥ arcāyāṃ lakṣaṇopetaṃ japayoge tathaiva ca tadeva sthānamityuktaṃ manobuddhyādi kalpitam stutyādividhi nirmuktaṃ parāpasthamidaṃ smṛtam yadi sarvagato devassarvāvasthoṣvavasthitaḥ ubhayārthaprasidhyarthaṃ śaivaṃ jñānamudāhṛtam sarvaṅgateṣu bhagavān na hi deheṣu pūjyate āvāhanamanudhyānaṃ mano bhukti nirodhanam arcayet sakalaṃ devaṃ japetsakalaniṣkalam

vyomni sphaṭikaśuddhābhaṃ jarāmṛtyuvināśanam snāne tu nirmalo mantrī japātsiddhirna saṃśayaḥ dhyānena sarvagaṃ devaṃ yogayogitvamāpnuyāt āvāhanaṃ sthāpanañca sānnidhyaṃ sannirodhanam na caivāvāpyate kaścinna ca kaścinniveśyate vyāpī mantrasvarūpeṇa cintayanti paraṃ śivam samādhistho'pi deveśa kathaṃ tiṣṭhati niścalaḥ yogaḥ pañcavidhaḥ proktaḥ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇaḥ teṣāṃ hi calate nityaṃ karmāsaktamanassadā eteṣāṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhati tadevaṃ kṛtakṛtyaḥ san nyaste sanyāsa ucyate atītya prakṛtauhyaṣṭau vartante puruṣeśvarā dvaitabhāvārthasaṃsiddhā punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vrajanti te nirodhādyogasaṃsiddhiḥ mokṣasteṣāṃ na vidyate nāsau sāyujyamāpnoti na bhavedyāvadekatā na teṣāṃ tu paraṃ sthānaṃ ātmendriyaniṣūdanāt etatsaṃśayayogīnāṃ gatānāṃ punarāgamaḥ vidyā yogātmikā devi vidyābhāvādhigacchataḥ avaśyāveśyayogitvātte tu vyāpyamudāhṛtam na yogī yuñjakaḥ kaścinna ca cakṣurnimīlitam sāvalaṃbehyanityatvaṃ nirālaṃbepi śūnyatā yathā śiśurakiñcijjño mūḍhopyuktā na śāyitaḥ ajñāyamāne tajjñānaṃ jñāte sat jñeyamiṣyate yathā tajjñeyayogena manasthāsyati niścalam manastu kathayiṣyāmi caturbhedasamāyutam

sātvikaṃ rājasañcaiva tāmasañca viśeṣataḥ caturthantu mahadyogaṃ anaupamyamanāmayam yena vijñātamātreṇa unmanatvaṃ sa gacchati manaścaturvidhaṃ proktaṃ bhedaṃ tasya imaṃ śṛṇu svalīno viṣayairmuktā ekībhūtassuṣuptavat na ca tairyujyate jñātassaṃ śiṣṭassa tu ucyate calate yasya daurbalyāt tasyā'sau gatirāgatiḥ trikālamātalo nityaṃ sa tu vikṣipta ucyate madhyamassa tu vijñeyo saṃśiṣṭassātvikaḥ smṛtaḥ tāmasaḥ sa tu vikṣiptaḥ caturthohyadhamo mataḥ nirguṇatve'dhikatvena yatra līno bhaviṣyati suṣuptādadhikatvena ceti nātra viśeṣaṇam na cānyo jñāpakastatra yāvannasvatasvayam yogāvasthā parā hyeṣā prāhuryogavido janāḥ tadāhyaśeṣavijñānaṃ vināśamupagacchati calito'pi manastasya calitvā yāsyate kutaḥ jñeyaṃ sarvasamatvañca dhyānānnirviṣayaṃ manaḥ nirguṇo lakṣya rahitaḥ śivayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ yathā vāyuḥ suśīghro'pi muktvā'kāśaṃ na gacchati bhuṅkte tu viṣayān sarvān nāsau lehyalepakaḥ kāyānubandhicalite nā'sau calati niścalaḥ evaṃ yonijito dhīraissa gatvā kiṃ kariṣyati rāgakṣaye tadā puṃsāṃ manaśśīghraṃ nivartate sa ca tyāgī śarīrasya suruddho na bhaviṣyati trayodaśa vidhastena karaṇaṃ niścalīkṛtam

niścalaṃ na kadācit syāt ayutasya yutasya vā puryaṣṭakaṃ ca tanmātraṃ budhyahaṃkārameva ca calate tu sadā devi sukhaduḥkhena mohitāḥ yasya tulyasukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ manastasya suniścalam na yogī yuñjakaścaivārthatastu tvayā vibho kathaṃ yogaṃ mahādeva jñeyasya kathayasva me hṛccātināsikāgrasya vīkṣaṇānna nimīlanam pratipūritavadvāyuḥ sūkṣmeṇa suṣireṇa tu vāyupūrṇaśarīrantu dṛtivallakṣyate prabho kṛtakasya tu adhvānaṃ jñātavyaṃ sarvathā vibho etanme saṃśayaṃ deva yattsatyaṃ tadbravīhi me guṇavadgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā kathayetparameśvaram prakramādhvānamārgantu uccārakaraṇāni ca evaṃ sa nirjito tiṣṭhet mano durjayacañcalam anirjito yathā mallo darpaṇīkurute bahūn na hi gantā bhavetkaścit gantavyañca na vidyate ghaṭasaṃvṛtamākāśaṃ nīyamānamitastataḥ kadalīsāravaddehaṃ vṛtaṃ tatvadalaissthitam nirākārātmavijñāne bhāvanāgatacetasaḥ mokṣo nāma sa vikhyāto sa śarīro nirākṛtiḥ na mokṣasya bhavettasmāt na cādhvānaṃ kadācana bāhuśo yastu vairāgyaṃ ātmā nirvyāpitastu yaiḥ evamanye'pi ye kecit nirvāpyante virāgitām yathā śilāśritaṃ toyaṃ kṣapitaṃ sūryaraśmibhiḥ na tattoyagataṃ bhūmyā na ca tatraiva tiṣṭhati

evaṃ grāhyātmavairāgyaṃ yaduktaṃ guruṇā hitam kā hyāśā mokṣavādīnāṃ yatra sarve kṣayaṃ gatāḥ yannāsti tatra santoṣaṃ prāyaḥ kaścitkariṣyati nadīnāṃ sāgaraṃ prāpya nāmarūpaṃ nivartate na cānyo jāyate tatra udakasya viśeṣaṇam evaṃ nadyupamo dehī nirvāṇaṃ sāgaropamam tiṣṭhate niścalatvaṃ hi tṛptisthaṃ tasya jāyate abhāve bhāvamālaṃbya bhāvaṃ kṛtvā nirāśrayam abhāve bhāvamāśritya bhāvalīnopyaśaṅkitaḥ abhāvasya kuto bhāvaḥ niṣkalasya mahātmanaḥ yasya jāgre pralīyante sarve bhāvāssuṣuptavat pūrvakohyakṣaro jñeyaḥ surecitamanakṣaram sarvaṃ tyaktvā samādhistha antaḥkaraṇagocaram gurūpadeśanirdiṣṭaṃ saṃpradāyaṃ yathā sthitam pitṛyānapathaṃ deva devayānaṃ tathaiva ca pitṛyānena gacchante iṣṭāpūrtaratā divi kṛtakṣaye nivartante punarjāyanti bhūtale pathaṃ cāndramasaṃ sarvaṃ miḍā tasya tu sārathiḥ kṣīyate vardhate candra asthiro viṣamaścalaḥ devayānapathe sūryaḥ suṣumnā tasya sārathiḥ sarvabhūtātmabhūtānāṃ sādhūnāṃ tatvadarśinām na te bhūyo nivartante devayānena yoginaḥ evaṃ pathaṃ vidurdevi pitṛyānaṃ samāsataḥ pathena gamyate yatra yatkiñcitparikalpitaḥ yathā'dhvānañca yogañca sarvatantraṃ na vidyate

tanmānārthamidaṃ vākyaṃ devayāne yathā tathā yatra gamyati tannāsti na ca tatra pathā kvacit gatirnāvartate vaśyaṃ sudūreṣvapi yogataḥ yaḥ kaścitpitṛyānena pathena tu gato naraḥ devayānena so gatvā sarvapāpairvivarjitaḥ karaṇañcaiva saṃjñā ca ahaṅkāraṃ tathaiva ca aiśvaryaṃ coditaṃ śāstre alpasatvamanaupamam yasyeśvaro'pi nairāśyaṃ nirāśaṃ saṃpraśasyate ātmārthe sarvakāryāṇi āśābhūtaḥ pravartate tāvadbadhyati saṃsāre yāvadāśā na muñcati atītānāgatañcaiva vartamānaṃ tathaiva ca jātaṃ nāsti tathā'vaśyaṃ ajātañca viśeṣataḥ ajātatvādajo nāsti jātaṃ nāstyavināśakam kāmamūlo mahāvṛkṣaḥ saṃsārastīkṣṇakaṇṭakaḥ kāmarāganna * * * * sa jiṣyati paṇḍitaḥ prāguktāṅgabalaṃ sarvaṃ vidyuddarśanasannibham tasmācchidraṃ pavitrañca kṣemamaṅgulameva ca pātālassaptalokāntaḥ sarvametadvibhīṣikā na hutaṃ na ca vā dattanna paratra nacaihikam bandhavyo bandhanañcaiva tathā caivānyabandhakaḥ agnidarbhāśca mantrāśca hotā hotavyameva ca agnihotrādayo yajñā vedāśca ṛṣayastathā sarve mantrātmakā devā devo mantragaṇasmṛtaḥ tatra mantrāṇi vartante tatra jñeyaṃ suniṣkalam sarve dharmā virudhyante paramārthasya niścayāt

na ca nāsti kriyā yajñā astitve ca phalapradāḥ nā pṛṣṭhaḥ kasyacidbrūyāt na cānyāyena pṛcchitaḥ vidito yogasadbhāve tadākṣamapunargṛhī virāge niścayo yasya jñeyasya prāṅ nivedayet tasya tyāgaḥ kṛto yena tadvirāgasya lakṣaṇam saspṛhe cāvarakte ca duṣṭacitte'jitendriye tasmātsanyāsinaṃ muktvā nākhyeyaṃ kasyacittvayā siddhānte brūhi ko doṣo gṛhasthānāṃ prakāśate siddhānte kevalaṃ jñānaṃ dharmakāmārthavarjitam na sidhyate ca tatkāryaṃ tasyāraṃbho nirarthakaḥ oṣadhīnnaiva sidhyeta matigrastasya dehinaḥ na doṣoyamiyadbrūhi śrūyatāṃ kena hetunā kadācidyajate yajñaṃ tena yajño vidūṣitaḥ vidhiyajña pramāṇastu saspṛhasya na yujyate gṛhasthasya parityāgo na kadācidbhaviṣyati gṛhastho'pi parityaktuṃ aihikaṃ naiva śakyate upādānantu vittasya sarvopāyena kāraṇam pañcasu nādṛtairdoṣaiḥ gṛhīṇāṃ gṛhyate tadā na sa tyajati saṃsāralobhamohatamo vrataḥ īśāvāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ yatkiñca jagatāṃ jagat tadgṛhasthasya kiṃ bāhyamasmin lokepyavasthitam tasmātsundari tasyāpi gṛhe muktirna dṛśyate na māyā matsarādyukto gṛhastho'pi na sidhyati pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca dvividhaṃ karma kīrtitam lokasya sarvato maunī samaśśāntaḥ samāhitaḥ

nopakārāya yatkiñcit na cānyo jāyate guṇaḥ upakārakṛtastena pareṣāṃ hitakāmyayā anena hetunā duḥkhaṃ śarīrādvinivartate anena hetunā duḥkhaṃ śarīrādvinivartate asya vairāgyayogasya kiṃ bhavetsiddhi vā na vā śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ tasyasiddhimanaupamām sakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva karaṇādhāravarjitam amanastha mahāyogaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ taṃ labdhvā labdhamātrastu yathā siddhiṃ labhennaraḥ svaravarṇavihīnastu sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham bhrānti nirnāśanaṃ hyetat sarvajñānārtha sādhakam etaddevi mahājñānaṃ vijñānaṃ śūnyamavyayam jñeyametatsamākhyātaṃ jarāmṛtyuvināśanam acintyaṃ sūkṣmamākāśamaśeṣavyāpakaṃ param tasmiṃsthāne tu yatkiñcit sparśamīṣadvibhāvayet na devā nāsurā yakṣā na nāgā na ca rākṣasāḥ na vasuḥ na ca vidyā ca vidyādharagaṇena ca na vāyussalilañcaiva na vṛkṣā na ca parvatāḥ na brahmā na ca vai viṣṇuḥ nāhaṃ devi tvayā saha evaṃ yo bhāvayedyogī vitataṃ śūnyamavyayam daṣṭo yadi mahānāgairanantagulikādibhiḥ aparañca parañcaiva sarvamasmin pratiṣṭhitam dharmādharmakṣayaṃ karma janmavyādhi vināśanam dīkṣayitvā mahādevi dātavyaṃ suparīkṣite idaṃ tatvamidaṃ tatvamidaṃ jñānamidaṃ sarvajñameva ca

evaṃ vadanti bahava anyonyajñānagarvitāḥ brahmacārīti vaktavyamaho śānteti vā punaḥ śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ sa mudrābhinayamuttamam savyahastena kartavyaṃ mudrābandhamanuttamam yadi syāt jñāninaḥ kaścit jñānino gṛhamāgataḥ evaṃ jñānī yadā jñānaṃ pṛṣṭavyaṃ punareva hi tadā tasya punardevi pṛṣṭavyāḥ guravaḥ kramāt tadā tatpūjayeddevi śivavacchivasaṃmataḥ yena vijñātamātreṇa na punarjanma cāpnuyāt madhyamāyāṃ sthito rudraḥ tarjanyāmajamīśvaraḥ tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakau lagnau nītordhvaṃ visṛjetpunaḥ madhyamānāmikā caiva kaniṣṭhāyā samanvitaḥ jñātenā'nena mudrāyā mucyate pāśabandhanāt kṛtāñjali puṭābhūtvā devī vacanamabravīt bindudevasya vijñānamaṣṭabhedasya śaṅkara na yatra sūtre deveśa patisadbhāvamuttamam punaśca śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi kathayasva maheśāna praśnaṃ guhyataraṃ prabho sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ kathayāmi mahāphalam tarkaścaiva samādhiśca ṣaḍaṅgo yoga ucyate yogasya karaṇānyete kathitāni mayā tava dhyānadhāraṇacintābhiḥ yogāraṃbhakriyādibhiḥ yadātmapīḍārahitaṃ vinā kleśairavāpyate purāṇe sāṃkhyayoge ca yādṛśaṃ kathitaṃ prabho yogadhāraṇasaṃyuktā vedādyāḥ parameśvara

anākhyeyamanirdeśyaṃ bhagavan kathitantu yat prakṛtiṃ puruṣañcaiva niyatiṃ kālameva ca vinā tu karaṇairdevo dhyānadhāraṇavarjitaḥ ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi yogasadbhāvamuttamam yetadatyantasukhadamaśeṣaphalabhūṣitam yadetadamṛtaṃ brahma janassarvo'dhigacchati sarve dharmāḥ pralīyante vedayajñatapaḥ kriyāḥ yānti devā adevatvamadhyā tapa vivarjitāḥ yogadharmārtha śāstrāṇi vistīrṇagahanāni ca videhacakramārūḍhamevaṃ bhrāmyati vai jagat tvayā durlalitenāhaṃ pṛṣṭo bhaktyā pracoditaḥ na brahmā na ca vai viṣṇuḥ utānye surasattamāḥ tasmācchṛṇuṣva sadbhāvaṃ nissaṃdigdhamavistaram siddhidā mokṣadā caiva tuṣṭidā puṣṭivardhanā ghoṣiṇī piṅgalā caiva vaidyutī bindumālinī saumyā nirañjanā caiva nirālaṃbā ca kathyate pūrvamātmā tu medhāvī śivena parameṇa tu ekāgramanaso bhūtvā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ dvitīyā piṅgalā nāmnā sā tatve pañcaviṃśake saptaviṃśati me tatve vijñeyā bindumālinī ekonatriṃśatitame mātrā tiṣṭhenmanonugā ekaviṃśat samāśritya saumyā mātrā vyavasthitāḥ trayastriṃśe nirālaṃbā tasyā lakṣaṃ na vidyate teṣu lakṣaṇadinyāni lakṣitavyā vipaścitaiḥ teṣāmavāptiṃ gamayan kathaṃ sadyopalabhyate

sīdantyāyāsabahulaiḥ mṛgāḥ kūṭeva saṃsthitāḥ sadyopalabdhisukhadaṃ tanme brūhi maheśvara yaṃ prāpya sadyaśśivatāṃ labhantyāyāsavarjitāḥ līyante tu yathā lakṣe nimeṣādhye tu ? tato'sya sarvato vyāpī dhvanirūrdhvaṃ vijṛmbhate tasya tena prayogena śabdamāhurakṛtrimam tasmāt ṣaḍjādayassapta svayaṃbhurasṛjatpurā sapta svarāstu saṃbhūtā dhvanimabhyasatassadā rajastamaṃ tato bhitvā jyotirante prakāśate tribhirmāsai svatantraśca śivatvaṃ tasya jāyate lakṣesmin manasā jñānaṃ nāvajñāṃ kartumarhasi śvapaceṣvapi bhuñjānāḥ padmapatramivāṃbhasi ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi layamāyāsavarjitam sūryātape bahisthitvā kiñcit bhaktisamāśritaḥ yathā yathā tu caitasmin mano lakṣe samādadhe evaṃ māsaprayogena mūdhnicāramapāvṛtam devayānapathaṃ dṛṣṭvā paśyatātmānamātmani dhūmānumārgāñjyotīṃṣi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhṛtaṃ padam evaṃ te piṅgalālakṣaṃ manasā parilakṣitam anena vidhinā deva tejasā parisaṃvṛtaḥ cintitaṃ manasā sarvaṃ saṃpādayati līlayā pañcaviṃśati me tatve lakṣametatprakīrtitam pañcaviṃśatimaṃ lakṣaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane yogāraṃbhaṃ vināyāmaṃ līlāmārgopaśobhitam vinā dīpāndhakāre tu udvatya nayane sa tu

saudāminīva capalāṃ dṛṣṭvā draṣṭṛ praṇaśyati sthitvā kālāntaraṃ kiñcit tānyevābhyasataḥ punaḥ tathā vardhati tattejastailabindurivāṃbhasi tāneva tu gṛhān vidvān paśyate ca na saṃśayaḥ dṛṣṭvā jvalanaṃ sarvatra divyaṃ cakṣuḥpravartate etatte kathitaṃ lakṣaṃ suṣumnāyāṃ vyavasthitam tatasvacchandatāmeti śivatatvena saṃśayaḥ tasyopalabdhiṃ tasyāpi lakṣantu kathayāmi te kiñcidunnamya vaktrantu śuddhamālokyennabhaḥ jyotisphaṭikasaṃkāśā nipatantyutpatanti ca yathā yathā hi yogena tasmin lakṣaṃ sa sandadhe anekākāravaśye tu sa bāhyābhyantare sthitāḥ trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ subhagaḥ priyadarśanaḥ eṣa te kathitā mātrā saumyākhyā bindumālinī saptaviṃśati me tatve lakṣamāyāsavarjitam yogāraṃbhaṃ vināyāsaṃ mantroccāravivarjitam pūrvamadhyā parā hetuḥ abhyasellakṣamuttamam varcasaṃ sphaṭikābhantu lakṣayetparamāṇavam ekaikābhyāsayogena sidhyate sādhakeśvaraḥ uccāṭane yathonmatte yojayedyogavitsadā āpyāyanañca puṣṭiśca śāntikādi krameṇa ca pratimāsaprayogena ebhiḥ karmāṇi kārayet pratyakṣaṃ jāyate tasya sidhyante ca śivo bhavet pañcarūpadharaṃ hyetat pañcamaṃ yatprakīrtitam teṣāṃ madhye punaryogī paśyate ūrmisaṅkulām

sabhoga bhogisaṅkāśāmindrāyudhasamaprabhām tathā tathā tu saṃpaśya ūrmirevatirantaram satatābhyāsayogena sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ divyadṛṣṭitanurdivyā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ manaścāvalokanam antardhāno tathā karṣo pādacāre tathaiva ca āgneyaiḥ śoṣaṇaṃ kuryāt tāḍanaṃ māraṇāni ca āpyāyanāditaḥ kṛtvā vāruṇena tu kārayet aṣṭāviṃśati mātrasya lakṣahyetāḥ prakīrtitāḥ lakṣitavyā prayatnena yadicchetsiddhimātmanaḥ ātmā tu kāñcanacchāyā akṣṇī āvṛtya tiṣṭhati sitaraktapītakṛṣṇamindrāyudhasamaprabham lakṣayīta punastāntu rājikāparivarttulām sarvadevamayo devi devānāñca pṛthak pṛthak tayoryogī divārātrau nānyaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā sugandhāsya tanurdivyā jāyate tṛptireva ca naśyanti puṇyapāpāni tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ekonatriṃśake tatve tulyametadvarānane tasya lakṣamidaṃ devi śṛṇu ekamanā mama kaṇṭhatālvoṣṭharahitaṃ mantroccāravivarjitam aprayogamanāraṃbhamanāyāsopalakṣitam tasya yatnāt śṛṇu devi ākāśe manasaṃ dadhet cittaṃ śrotra samādhāya bāhyaśabdavivarjitam yavanikā'karṇayeddevi puṇyapāpakṣayaṅkarīm sadṛśaṃ śabda ākarṇya amṛtattvāya kalpate

tasyābhyāsena satataṃ cidrā paśyati medinīm prāpnoti subhagatvañca dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet śivasya vai sa vijñeyaḥ sāmānyatvātprakāśakaḥ bindunā sahitenaiva rudrākāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ svacchandavṛttiḥ sūkṣmo'yaṃ nidhānoṅkāra ucyate bindunā sahito devi tṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitam śrīkaṇṭhādimanantāntaṃ rudroṅkārassa ucyate śāntividyādhikā siddhiḥ nidhane nidhanāntikā tribhinnametatsakalamadhvānaṃ parikīrtitam uccāreṇa yadā hīno binduṃ niṣkalatāṃ gataḥ saumyanāḍīti vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī yaśśabdaḥ śrūyate devi rudroṃkārassa ucyate ekattriṃśadvijānīyāt śivoṅkārastu tatparaḥ vyāpakena samāyuktā nāḍī proktā narañjanā satatā'bhyāsayogena sādhakānāṃ prayacchati dūraśravaṇavijñānaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhāṣitam vyāpto'ti kāmarūpitvaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ tathaiva hi ghaṇṭānādavirāmānte śivoṅkāraṃ nigadyate kālatatvaḥ sa evokto nāḍīproktā nirañjanā nirālaṃbaṃ pravakṣyāmi navatatvaphalapradam paścāttu parametattu na kiñcidapi cintayet dvāttriṃśakassamākhyāto nirālaṃbe pare sthitaḥ taṃ jñātvā devi siddhyante lakṣaitatparikīrtitam siddhidaṃ mokṣadañcaiva diṣṭantattu vicintayet etanna kasyaciddeyaṃ jñānāmṛtamidaṃ śubham

paraṃ tāvadidaṃ devi tattvānāṃ parikīrtitam sarveṣāndhārakassohi sa vai cā'dhāra varjitaḥ vettisarvamaśeṣeṇa lokahetu vivarjitaḥ teṣāñca uttaraṃ vācyaṃ yenopāyena īśvaram yo brūyāt kaścit kaśśabdo vināśitvena paṭhyate triguṇaḥ pudgalo vāyurākāśasyātha vā guṇaḥ padavākyātmakasphoṭaḥ praṇamya vinivartate vākyaṃ padāśrayaṃ sarvaṃ padaṃ varṇāśrayaṃ smṛtam prāṇo hi bhagavān vāyurākāśāśraya ucyate bhūtādistu mahāścaiva sa caivāparamāśritaḥ tasmādapi paro devaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ tadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ paro'yaṃ paramo mataḥ yatrā'sau paramo devaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ śabdena sādhyate devo śabdo nāsti tu devatā trividho'tha vinirmuktassūkṣmaśśabdassa ucyate tena divyena śabdena nityaṃ dṛśyamanāmayam sarvaśabdaviśiṣṭo'sau anaupamyamanāmayam śrutimātrarasādyeṣāṃ pradhānapuruṣeśvarān vinā śabdena yaśśabda hutabhuṅmāṣasannibhaḥ ghoṣorāvasvanaśśabdo sphoṭākhyo dhvanireva ca śravaṇāṅguṣṭhasaṃyogādyaśśabdassaṃprajāyate ghoṣyate tu yaśśabdaḥ īṣanmando vibhāvyate tato vaṃśadhvanissūkṣmo nivātavarṣopamam caturthantu mahaśśabdaḥ sarvaśabdabhacāriṇīm pañcamantu mahaśśabdaṃ sarvayogihitāvaham

śabdatatvapare līnaṃ śabdāntargatamānasaḥ vaṃśadhvanivinirmukto yaśśabdassaṃpravartate mṛduvīṇāsvanaśśabdaḥ śāntaghaṇṭanināditaḥ jhaṅkārastu smṛtaḥ śabdaḥ samasta parameśvarī sakalākalasaṃghātaṃ vajrapātasubhairavam sa śivaśśivatatvastho dhvaṃkṛtaḥ praṇavasmṛtaḥ sevitavyāḥ prayatnena yadicchet siddhimātmanaḥ anānāttvena vartante nānātvena maheśvara vācyavācakarūpo vā nā saṃbandhaḥ prayujyate svabhāvasyāvinābhāvī nānyā nānyatayā mataḥ anyārthavācakasso vai sarveṣāñca tadā bhavet vijñānamivajñānaṃ śabdaprakṛṣṭantukantat śabdastu pāśayeddharmo śamakāmārthasādhakaḥ śabdena sādhyate hyartho hyartha eva tu śabdataḥ vācā śabdanibandhāstu prabhuḥ prabhavatāmiha yo yasyārthasya niṣpatīḥ bhūtagrāme caturvidhe yadarthahīnaṃ loke'smin vacanaṃ saṃpravartate gamakāścaiva śabdāstu ṛṣidaivatabhāṣitāḥ saṃskṛtenāpi kiṃ tena mṛdunā lalitena ca yacchṛtvā jāyate puṇyaṃ pāpādīnāṃ parikṣayaḥ putradārādi saṃsāraḥ puṃsāṃ saṃmūḍhacetasām dehe dehe yadā katvaṃ vijñātatvaṃ carenmukhāt kecidvadanti puruṣāstadidaṃ sumithyā tvaṃ māṃsakīṭakaphaśoṇitamūtramadhye yaddṛśyate gṛhagṛhe'pi jagatsamastā

evaṃ pareṇa paramasthitasūkṣmaśaktyā aṣṭau śabdāḥ parāḥ sūkṣmāḥ ke tatvā varṇakāśca ye etāni kathayiṣyāmi sarvatatveṣu devatāḥ na pāpmano varārohe te varṇāste ca devatāḥ devaistattvaiḥ samāyukto me kṣareṇa ca sundari śabde ca devatāssarve brahmādyāśca varānane devāśśabdaparandhāma śabdāt varṇā samudbhavāḥ śabdāt sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaram śabdadhyānaparo bhūtvā yo'bhyasetsusamāhitaḥ prathamaṃ yat spṛśecchabdaṃ prākṛtaṃ siddhidāyakam tṛtīyaṃ yatparaṃ śabdaṃ niyataṃ siddhidāyakam tena dhyānena deveśe sarveṣāṃ phalabhāk bhavet ṣaṣṭhaṃ yacchabdatattvantu vidyā nāmnā tu sā smṛtā saptamaṃ yatparaṃ tatvaṃ īśvaraṃ taṃ pravakṣyate aṣṭamaṃ yatparaṃ śabdamanaupamyamanāmayam navamaṃ yatparaṃ devi sarvaśabdamayaṃ smṛtam tena dhyānena deveśi sarveṣāṃ phalabhāk bhavet tena te kathito binduśśabdarāśimayastataḥ vijñaptimātraṃ tatraiva pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitam varṇatatvasamūhantu jñātaṃ me tvatprasādataḥ yogaṃ dhyānañca deveśa vidyeśānāṃ tathaiva ca śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchritam na mayā kasyacit khyātaṃ idaṃ yo varaṃ mahat śabdamātreṇa te tuṣṭā nāhaṃ pṛṣṭastu śobhane vidyeśānāṃ pravakṣyāmi aṇimāttāramaṃ bhavoḥ

karaṇena tu saṃprāptiḥ tasya sṛṣṭiṃ vadāmyaham vācakastatra mantro'yaṃ ūkāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ yogināmakṛtañcaiva paiśācaṃ yoniṣu smṛtam aṇimā tu tathaiśvaryaṃ tathā tuṣṭiḥ prakīrtitā prathame śabdatattve tu sṛṣṭireṣā prakīrtitā tasmin puruṣajāto hi tanmayā kathitaṃ tava sūkṣmo vidyeśvaraḥ prokto yogināntu kṛtasmṛtaḥ salilasṛṣṭirityuktā sutā rājñā na kīrtitā tṛtīye saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā mama vācakastu varārohe vidyeśānāṃ śivottamaḥ aiśvaryaṃ mahimā teṣāṃ moghā tuṣṭistathaiva ca caturthaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu tasmātkālaḥ samutpanno durjayaḥ sarvayoginām vidyeśa ekanetrastu tasmiṃstu kathitastava prāptiraiśvarya deveśi caturthe kathitaṃ tava pramodo jñānamākhyātaṃ caturthe kathitaṃ tava sphoṭaśśabdaparaśreṣṭho māyātatvasya saṃbhavaḥ paraṃ bhāvamajānanto śabdavādena mohitāḥ * * * * * * * * kathitaṃ tava śobhane yogināṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tatra pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam prākāmya iti vikhyātaḥ sutarā tuṣṭirucyate pañcamaṃ te samākhyātamanupūrvaṃ yathākramam dhvaniḥ pūrvaṃ mayā khyāto yasmin vidyāsamudbhavaḥ vidyeśānāṃ trimūrtistu kathitaścānu pūrvaśaḥ īśitvañca samākhyātaṃ guṇānāṃ surasundari

etatte kathitaṃ devi ṣaṣṭaṃ śabdamanuttamam jhaṅkāreti samākhyātaḥ tvasminnīśa samudbhavaḥ vidyeśāttu śrīkaṇṭho yogināmaumakīrtitam aiśvaryañca punastasmin śivatvaṃ tatprakīrtitam etatte tu samākhyātaṃ saptamaṃ śabdamuttamam dhvaṃkṛtante samākhyātaṃ yasmāttatvaṃ sadāśivam vidyeśānāṃ śikhaṇḍīśo yogī śrīkaṇṭha ucyate aiśvaryaṃ tatra deveśi sarvakāmāvasādhitā jñānaṃ tatra samākhyātaṃ sadā pramuditaṃ mayā jñānena mucyate jantuḥ aśeṣapaśubandhanāt binduścatuṣkalaścaiva śāntyatītaśca suvrate tathā te kathayiṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ mahat teṣāntu yajanaṃ vakṣye yathāvattannibodha me tatra padmaṃ samālikhya aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam anantaḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ padmaśaktiṃ tathā purā hṛtpadme tu yathā proktaṃ nyāsaṃ mantrañca tādṛśam akṛtaṃ dakṣiṇe caiva paiśācaṃ nair-ṛtena tu uttareṇa tu vinyasya tārājñānaṃ samāhitaḥ madhye ghoṣantu vinyasya idaṃ kuryāttataḥ punaḥ tritattvaṃ kārayettatra ghoṣamārgaṃ yathākramam plutena tu sadā kuryāt śivatattvantu sarvataḥ kartavyaṃ devadeveśi sarveṣāmanupūrvaśaḥ ye varṇā devatā proktāḥ pūrvādārabhya sundari sakalaṃ bhaumakarmeṣu sarveṣāṃ parikalpayet śabde śatantu hotavyaṃ tritatve triśataṃ hunet

dhyāyecchabdamayaṃ devaṃ siddhimokṣārthakāṅkṣitaḥ lokapālaiśca vidyaiśaiḥ astreṇaiva tu suvṛte saddravye dravyayāgantu nirdhane dhyānameva ca dvitīye niṣkalaṃ tattvaṃ rāvaśśabdaḥ prakīrtitaḥ evamādikrameṇaiva śabde tatvaṃ yathākramam ājñāsiddhi ca deveśi na kiñcidapi cintayet pratimāsaprayogena śabdasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ nānena sadṛśī siddhiḥ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate jñātavyaṃ paramaṃ kiñcit śabdajñānaṃ paraṃ bhavet binduḥkalā catuṣkoṇakalāśakticatuṣṭayam utkṣaṇī ukārastu śaktistu prathamā kalā amṛtā tu tṛtīyā vai ikāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ bindudevakalā yā tu mayā pūrvamudāhṛtā prathamaṃ bindudevasya kalāṃ pūrveṇa vinyaset caturthīṃ uttare caiva kalā bindoḥ prakīrtitā amṛtā nāma kalā yā tu vāyavyena tu vinyaset nādaśāktasamāyuktaṃ karṇikāyāntu vinyaset brahmāviṣṇustathā rudraḥ trayo vai varṇatasthitāḥ tattvena vitatāssarve sarve tatvā na saṃśayaḥ śataṃ śatañca homena dīkṣā nirvāṇagāminī ānupūrveṇa boddhavyaṃ śaktināde sa binduke devā apyasya yāgasya īhante surasundari nā śiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ nābhaktāya kadācana sarvādhvānavidhijñasya dātavyā vidhirīdṛśī anyathā tu na dātavyaṃ ājñaiṣā pārameśvarī

dhāraṇā dhyānayogena karotyanugrahecchayā eteṣāṃ tu avibhāgo'yaṃ yattvayā hṛdi gopitam eteṣāṃ kathayiṣyāmi ekaikasya vibhāgaśaḥ padmāni ca yathā loke ādityaḥ saṃprabodhayet dūrastho'pi samīpasthaḥ piṇḍasthaḥ piṇḍavarjitaḥ sūkṣmātsūkṣmataro nityaṃ dūrāddūrataro vibhuḥ tattvāni devatāścaiva vibhāgena yathā sthitāḥ teṣāṃ sthānavibhāgañca svaśarīre yathākramam dehapadmaṃ pravakṣyāmi vyomapadmaṃ viśeṣataḥ ādityāḥ karṇikā jñeyāḥ puṣkare dvādaśa smṛtāḥ tasyāhaṃ bhāvito devi śeṣā ye bhrāmitā janāḥ tasya madhye sthitaṃ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇantu nābherūrdhvaṃ vyavasthitam aṅguṣṭhaparvatulyantu karṇikā vai sa kesarā candramadhye bhavedvahniḥ vahnimadhye maheśvaraḥ sarveṣāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ śivanirmitam somādūnaṃ vijānīyāt vahnimaṇḍalamuttamam bhūtā sumātramīśānaṃ jvalatkaṭakasannibham sadāśivaṃ mahātmānaṃ tasyāpyūrdhvaṃ parāparam dehanālaṃ samākhyātaṃ brahmapatramayaṃ viduḥ avyaktadakṣiṇe patre buddhiñcaiva tu nair-ṛte uttare tanmātramīśānyāṃ rasanaṃ tathā patrānteṣu mahābhūtāḥ kesarāṇi tu indriyāḥ yo'sau hṛdyuparodhī tu tāmaso nidrarūpiṇaḥ ante tu karṇikā cetā bhāvaiśca saha saṃyutāḥ

padmanāle sthitā devāḥ kaṇṭakeṣvadhasthitāḥ grahanakṣatratārāśca yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ sarvadevamayaṃ padmaṃ yo bhitvā jñānasūcibhiḥ jāgrataścāsya sarvasya ācāryaḥ prabhurucyate dīkṣakastu guruśreṣṭhaśśivatatvasya pāragaḥ mantramūrtismṛtācāryo mantramūrtiparaśśivaḥ tasmātsarveṣu bhūteṣu anugrahaṃ saṃpravartate śivo deśikadehasthaḥ prāṇyanugrāhakārakaḥ yattacchāntaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇādhipam aṇimādiguṇāṃ siddhiṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇam tritattvasya tu yadbhūtaṃ akṣarādviditaṃ yathā yo yathā'vasthitohyartho guṇadoṣasvabhāvataḥ kathaṃ loke hyavijñātaṃ sarvajñatve tathā vada sarvajñatvaṃ tadā tasya sarvopāyo vibhāvitam paiśunyamanṛtadraupyaṃ vayo'tīteṣvapi nṛṣu ebhirevāvṛto lokastena devaṃ na vindati dīkṣayetsarvajantūni dhyānenānena suvṛte ekena sarvabhūtāstu tatvāścaiva varānane manasā gṛhyate devi yujyate manasā paśuḥ manasā gṛhyate yasmāt tasmādevānmanātmakaḥ sarvaiḥ karaṇayogaiśca upalabdhuṃ maheśvare evaṃ tatvāni vinyasya śivāhyupari vinyaset mānasaṃ vidhimekantu kathitantu samāsataḥ śivantu sthtikartṛtve śānteti paramaṃ padam vidyā vai kesaraṃ tasya saṃhāraṃ karṇikāhyadhaḥ

etattritatvatattvādiṃ kailāsakamalaṃ viduḥ jihvā vai karṇikā proktā śarīrannālamucyate sagikā tālumadhye tu jihvā kailāsapiṇḍikā uccinoti ca śāstrāṇi ācāryastena paṭhyate trailokyamāyāpurasūtradhārī yastantu paśyetsatu sarvakārī iti vācanugrahaḥ * * * * * * * * * tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi tena sarvamidaṃ proktaṃ sūtre gaṇigaṇā iva tadidvalayasaṃkāśaṃ ghaṭikāyāṃ prakāśayet yaḥ paśyetparamaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sulekhyaṃ kartumarhasi teṣāṃ mantravivāho'yaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ śivātmakena mantreṇa śivayāge tu pūjayet ajñātvā kurute dīkṣāṃ śiṣyācāryau vrajatyadhaḥ nacābhyubhayoḥ patyanugraho'yaṃ pravartate aviditvā svayaṃ samyak kriyāṃ yaḥ kurute bhiṣak jñānavijñānakuśalaḥ sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi yaḥ sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi jñānavān gururucyate śivabhakto mahābhaktiḥ bhaktibhāvena deśikaḥ sa caivāṅkārabinduśca sa nādo layaniṣkalaḥ sarvavidyāsusaṃpūrṇaḥ sarvavidyārthakovidaḥ nānātvaṃ naiva kurvanti ananteśādayaḥ śivāḥ kīdṛśantu bhavedantaḥ āsanañca maheśvaraḥ bhāvārṇavavinirmuktāḥ śivaṃ yānti tanukṣaye icchāśaktisamudbhūtaṃ anantākhyaṃ tadāsanam vyā * * * * * * * śivasya paramātmanaḥ

sadāśivaśivādhāraṃ nityādhāreti saṃjñitam trayastriṃśatimāvidyā * * * * * * * * anādimūlapaṅkāḍhyaṃ jñānatoyasamudbhavam daśa koṭyastu mantrāṇāṃ śivapadme vyavasthitāḥ etadadhvanapadmantu śivākhye sarvamāśritam puruṣāṇāmanantatvāt tatvādīnāmanantatā paśūnāṃ bhuvanānāñca parisaṃkhyā na vidyate anādireṣa saṃsāro yasyānto na hi vidyate na padmasya pramāṇo'sti anantatvācchivasya tu anantaḥ khāpyate tena anantenatvadhiṣṭhitaḥ aprameyaṃ paśujñānaiḥ svatantre gīyate kalaiḥ kartṛtvamīśvaratvañca nityatṛptaḥ praśāntatā sakṛt sarvatra sat jñānaṃ sarvajñatvañca sarvadā viraktaḥ prākṛtairbhāvaiḥ nispṛhatvañca sarvadā aṇimādiguṇaissarvaiḥ yā bhūtyastvabhighātinī na tadbhuvanamadhvānaṃ na rūpaṃ na ca vāṅmayam virajannirmalaṃ vyomaṃ samantādanivāritam taptacāmīkarākāraṃ kvacitprāleyasannibham candracandrakasaṃkāśaṃ kvacinmaratakaprabham vyāpakaṃ aprameyañca padmaṃ sārvaṃ mahojvalam vyāpinībhiranantābhiḥ vrataṃ amṛtaśaktibhiḥ viśvasvacchaṃ mahātejaḥ svarūpānantavarcasam pradiṣṭhāstu guṇopetāḥ śivasyānantaśaktayaḥ śobhate nirmalaṃ tantu nirmalābhilaṅkṛtam atyantavimalaṃ śāntabhāsvaraṃ kamalacchadam
