ukṣepaṃ yojanañcaiva ebhiratra na kārayet evaṃ śudhyati adhvānaṃ saptadhā parameśvari sarvādhvānaṃ tvayā deva sūcitaṃ na tu vistṛtam ādisūtre yadadhvānaṃ sūtramātreṇa bhāṣitam dehādhvānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu caturvaktro mahātejā ādityodaya sannibhaḥ anantaṃ bhuvaneśānamadhastātparikalpayet adhikāre yathā bhoge laye vā'nukrameṇa tu evaṃ kālāgnirudrāya narakeṣu tathaiva ca ata ūrdhvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yogāṣṭamamanuttamam eteṣāmupariṣṭhāttu suśivā dvādaśasmṛtāḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ mahādevo vāmadevabhavodbhavau athordhvaṃ tatvasarge tu boddhavyaṃ deśikena tu asmin madhye tu ye tatvāḥ śodhanīyā vipaścitaiḥ tasyādhastātsmṛtāssarve śodhanīyāḥ śivādhvare prakṛterūpariṣṭhāttu bhāvasargaṃ vijānataḥ tuṣṭayaśśodhyāḥ deśikaissusamāhitaiḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ sthitaṃ devi nāḍī vidyāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam ata ūrdhvaṃ vigrahāṣṭakaṃ nigrahānugrahe sthitam prākṛte caiva tattve tu yasmin saṃskāra iṣyate bhūlokastu yadā prāptaḥ tiryagyoniṃ viśodhayet pakṣiyoniḥ tataśśodhyā mṛgāśca tadanantaram gavādyāḥ paśavaḥ proktāḥ siṃhādyāśca mṛgā smṛtāḥ saptacchadādyā deveśi sthāvarā parikīrtitāḥ antyajāḥ prathamaṃ śodhyāśśūdrayonistataḥ punaḥ

kṣudrādbrāhmeṣu saṃyojya adhikāraṃ yathākramam hiṃsakādi vidhānāni adhikāraṃ tyajetsadā adhikāraḥ sadā devi śūdratve parikīrtitaḥ kṣatrakriyāṃśastatraiva saṃsthitaṃ varavarṇinī kṣatriyāṇāmadhikāraḥ kathitantu yathākramam adhikārantu viprasya tava devi udāhṛtam aṣṭādhikañca vijñeyaṃ saṃśodhyā deśikena tu patnīsaṃyojanaṃ kṛtvā yajedyajñān sa dakṣiṇān sūtreṇa gaditaṃ pūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ tūrṇakārayet puruṣasyopariṣṭhāttu nityā śodhyā tu deśikaiḥ sukhapāśaṃ duḥkhapāśañca dvayaṃ śodhyaṃ samāsataḥ vimalaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi jñānamārgamataḥ param dīkṣākāle tu sarvete śodhanīyā vipaścitaiḥ kāle tatraiva vijñeyā ste tu śodhyā vipaścitaiḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ hariharādayo rāgatattve śodhanīyāḥ daśaite guravo jñeyāḥ vidyātatve tu śodhayet vāmo jyeṣṭhaśca rudraśca tatraiva parikīrtitāḥ asaṃkhyarudrakoṭībhiḥ gopatiḥ parivāritaḥ ata ūrdhvamananteśa pāśāñcaiva tu saṃsthitāḥ evamādikrameṇaiva śodhanīyāśśivādhvare pramāṇāṣṭakaṃ saṃśodhyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā atopari bhavedvidyā sarvavidyābhavāriṇī nava bhedavihīnastu punareva sa ucyate ananteśādayo vā'pi yaṣṭavyāstu samāhitaiḥ prāṇādhvani niṣṭhānāṃ dīkṣājñānasamanvitam

dīkṣākāle tu jñātavyā galake saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ ato nirañjano devaḥ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate tasyopariṣṭhādrudroṃkāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ sadāśivoṣṭabhedena bhruvormadhye vyavasthitaḥ tasyāsane sthitā nityaṃ catasro yogaśaktayaḥ puruṣākhyaḥ savijñeyaḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitaḥ aṇḍe'smin kurute rājyaṃ śivaśaktyā pracoditaḥ nādabrahmabile līnā padmasūtranibhā sthitā atopari mahādevi tejaśśabdamayaṃ mahat svaśaktikiraṇodyota jyotayantaṃ samāsataḥ sā śaktiḥ devadevasya dhyātavyā deśikena tu prakriyāntaṃ mahājñānamanaupamyamanāmayam vidyātattvāspadaṃ kṛtvā yojayetparame pade yavaṃ yavāntaraikaikaṃ saṃsthitā bhuvanāni tu puruṣaṃ hṛdi madhyasthaṃ niyatiṃ padabāhyataḥ jñātavyā deśikendreṇa dīkṣākāle samāhitaḥ vidyākaṇṭhapradeśe tu jñātavyā deśikena tu sadāśivastu mūrdhānte vyākhyā tatvaṃ parājite navātmakena dātavyaṃ athavā praṇavena tu sarvādhvanassamāptau tu śikhācchedantu kārayet tadeva mudrayā gṛhya chedayecca vicakṣaṇe ghṛtena saṃbhṛtāṃ kṛtvā homayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ upaspṛśyātha ācāryaḥ śucīkṛtvā svakāṃ tanum svanantaṃ paśutatvena ekīkṛtya vicakṣaṇaḥ kalādhvānaṃ yathā khyātaṃ prayogaṃ tādṛśaṃ kuru

śivadharme tu ye dharmāḥ bhavante sādhakasya tu gṛhaṇaṃ kena vā tasya etadicchāmi veditum gṛhaṇamāyatenaiva bindunā sahitena tu adhomukhakareṇaiva ekaikena tu suvṛte uttānena tu deveśi vāmayā tu niyojayet kartavyaṃ deśikendreṇa vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā kathaṃ teṣu sthitā dīkṣā kathaṃ yojyastu deśikaiḥ kalāyāgaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priye kalānāñcaiva deveśi yaṃ yaṃ yogaṃ vadāmyaham kalāpañca maheśasya catvāro vadanasya tu garbhāvaraṇametattu kathitaṃ tava suvṛte āgneyavāyunair-ṛtyā caturdhā puruṣaṃ nyaset aghorasya kalāhyaṣṭau tāntu vidyeśa vinyaset pūrvādārabhya kartavyaṃ kalānāñca niveśanam uttareṇa tu deveśi punarekāṃ kalāṃ nyaset śivasya paramā hyeṣā dehe tu parikalpayet aṣṭau diśāsu praṇave tu deveśi vinyasennavaśaktayaḥ anantapadmaṃ tenaiva kalpayedvaravarṇinī brahmoṅkāreṇa kartavyaṃ ātmatattvantu buddhimān nidrāgārantu deveśi vidyā tatve tu vinyaset āsanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ rudroṅkāraḥ sadeśikaiḥ pañcamī ca kalā yā tu īśānasya maheśvarī āsanaṃ kārayettena nidhanasya na saṃśayaḥ sakalīkṛtya cātmānaṃ vāhayetparamākṣaram pañcadhā praṇavaṃ tasya kalpayīta yathākramam

sadyavāmakalāyantaṃ nyaset sarvatra deśikaḥ gandhapuṣpaṃ tathā dīpaṃ balo bali nivedanam * * * * * tāḥ kalā nidhanena śivāntikam sadyojātakalātvena vāgīśvaryāṃ prakalpayet adhvānaṃ bhuvanākhyañca āhutīṃ tāvatīṃ hunet viśeṣakaraṇe caiva pratiyojya kale kale navātmakena deveśe śāntyatītena vā'thavā pūrvaṃ kalā sthāpya tato vāgīśvarīṃ nyaset kalādhvānaṃ yathā śodhyaṃ deśikaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ praṇavaikasmṛtastatra trayāṇāṃ varavarṇinī tasya vakṣyāmyahaṃ devi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu prakṛtyante tu deveśi hunettatra śataṃ śatam ekaikakalayā devi tattvekaikantu homayet puruṣamāditaḥ kṛtvā gṛdhyante tu samāsataḥ kalaikena tu deveśi juhuyādāhutīśśatam māyā'vidyā ca hotavyā aghorasya kalairbudhaḥ īśvarannaiva deveśe tathā tatvaṃ sadāśivam āhutīnāñca pañcāśanmekaikena tu homayet śivatatvantu hotavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā dvikalena tu deveśi vāme pūrṇāhuti smṛtā catuṣkalehyaghorasya pūrṇāhutyaśśivasya tu īśānakalāpañcena huneta varavarṇinī yojane karaṇaṃ yacca mayā pūrvamudāhṛtam etaddevi samākhyātaṃ kalādhvānamaśeṣataḥ bhuvanādhvā kalādhvā ca kathitastu samāsataḥ

evaṃ dīkṣāsamāptau tu ācāryaḥ susamāhitaḥ apare'hani deveśi yajeccaṇḍeśvaraṃ prabhum mantrāḥ pūrvaṃ mayā khyātāḥ ādisūtre varānane maṇḍale tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā hunedaṣṭaśataṃ kramāt * * * * * * sarvagarbhamuktvā varānane etatte padacakrantu tava devi udāhṛtam tṛtīye tu mahādevi vāyavyā varaṇānyaset ṣaṣṭhantu lokapālānāṃ māhendraṃ saptamaṃ smṛtam vidyāṅgarekhato dadyāt bāhyataḥ parameśvari aṣṭaikaikapadā ye tu te tu stotramudāhṛtam āsanādividhiṃ kṛtvā tadārambhya vā punaḥ śataṃ śatañca hotavyaṃ śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ekāśīti padañcaiva pūrvameva udāhṛtam pūrvokte bhūpradeśe tu tuṣakeśāsthivarjite prāgudakplavane deśe sūtrayedbhuvanaṃ śubham sūtrayitvā yathānyāyaṃ navabhāgena bhājayet navabhāgavibhakteṣu bhāgārdhantu vivarjayet caturvidhisamāyuktamaṣṭadvāropaśobhitam yathā madhyaṃ tathā sarve kartavyaṃ deśikaiḥ sadā ṣoḍaśāṅgulamityāhuḥ rekhāpadmasya cā * ktam śivāṅgācchṛṇu deveśi kathayāmi nibodha me jñātavyaṃ deśikenaiva dīkṣākāle na saṃśayaḥ vidyeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetat dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam saptamaṃ mahendrāvaraṇaṃ tārādyānāṃ prakīrtitam navamāvaraṇaṃ hyetat aṃbhādyānāṃ prakīrtitam

vidyāṅgā rekhato dadyādaiśvaryāste prakīrtitāḥ śivātmakamidaṃ sarvaṃ śivādeva pravartate varṇāsthe yajanaṃ proktaṃ śivāya paramātmane ekaikantu padaṃ yojya ekaikantu padaṃ hunet ekaikapadapīṭhena dīkṣāṃ nirvāṇagāminīm maṇḍalatarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā hunedekādaśātmakam ekāmatipadañcaiva hutvā saṃśodhya cādhvaram āvāharodhasānnidhyaṃ padaikaikantu śudhyati daśabhirdaśabhirāhutībhiḥ pīṭhaśuddhiṃ na saṃśayaḥ sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ vidhimetatsamācaret sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ sarvatantreṣu kīrtitam punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrasāraṃ suguhyakam tryakṣandaśabhujandevaṃ mayā pūrvamudāhṛtam padmāsanopaviṣṭantu dyotayantaṃ samantataḥ tatrasthaṃ śaktimadhyasthamādityodaya sannibham kvacidrasasusaṅghātaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva ca āsanaṃ tasya devasya dyotayanti samantataḥ tasyānte parato devi śaktistu parikīrtitā chitvātmasthaṃ paśuṃ kṛtvā tadā yojyeta suvṛte eṣa devi samākhyāta ātmā tu parameśvari mocayecca na sandehaḥ padmaṃ dṛṣṭvā pare śive tasmādyatnaparenaiva ddhyātavyo yogibhissadā svasthānāvasthitaṃ deśaṃ sarvaṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ patra patre yathānyāsaṃ kathayāmi maheśvari

ardhārdhapatrayogena pūrvadeśaṃ sa paśyati uttareṇa ca patreṇa paśyatepyuttaraṃ patham nai-ṛtyārdhena yogīndraḥ paścāddeśannirīkṣayet āgneyasyaiva cārdhena dakṣiṇāpatha paśyati dvitīye tāpanīproktā pratideśantu tāṃ viduḥ ātmānaṃ suṣiraṃ kṛtvā deśān kṛtvā tu madhyataḥ saritsamudranadayassarve'bhyantarīkṛtāḥ tatvarūpaṃ samākhyātaṃ te tu yā viditāḥ purā meruṃ tatkarṇikāṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ paśyate tadā etaddevi mayākhyātaṃ yogasadbhāvamuttamam ṣaṇmāsādyogayuktastu sarvaṃ paśyati nānyathā devaiśca samatāṃ yāti bhuvanāni yathākramam sidhyate nātra sandeho nirvighnassādhakeśvaraḥ sa siddhiṃ labhate kṣipraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā śāntidaṃ dakṣiṇe patre nair-ṛte caiva māraṇam uttaraṃ dhanamicchadbhiḥ īśānyāṃ jñānamicchatā dhyātavyaṃ devadeveśi mṛtyuduḥkhairna pīḍyate evaṃ jñātvā varārohe nayate nātra saṃśayaḥ tasyāhaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi adhastāttu kathaṃ deva nayate pāpakarmaṇaḥ mudrāyogavidhānañca kathayasva prasādataḥ yena vijñātamātreṇa sidhyante sādhako bhuvi śaivajñānaṃ pare divye śikhākarma manoramam śikhā mṛtyuñjayārthāya dhyātavyā yogibhissadā ācāryate jagatsarvaṃ viṣagrahavināśayet

na ca sroto vibhāgena sravanti yadi paśyati raktavarṇaśikhādhyānaṃ kṛtvā yogī yadā bhavet vaśīkaraṇamāveśaṃ māraṇaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā anagnijvalanañcaiva mūrcchakaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā pītavarṇādhareṇaiva śṛṇu vakṣyāmi suvṛte staṃbhayetpṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaram uccāṭanantu vidveṣa karaṇaṃ mocanaṃ tathā staṃbhanaṃ sarvatatvānāṃ viṣayasya ca na saṃśayaḥ śikhayā rahitaṃ karma naiva sidhyati sādhakaiḥ pītā mahendrī vijñeyā śuklā vāruṇi ucyate sarvakarmakarañcaiva śikhākarmavidassadā sarvatantreṣu sāmānyatantrasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ hanate muṣṭinākāśaṃ pibate mṛgatṛṣṇikām dīkṣāsaṃrodhanaṃ vakṣye tadekāgramanā śṛṇu tasya devi idaṃ kuryānnāsyaiva kadācana pañca pañcabhirāhutyā nīyate yatra rocate tiṣṭhate tatra duṣṭātmā laṅghane yastu deśikaḥ siddhirodhaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi yathā bhavet māhendreṇa tu sañcchādya kṣitirūpadhareṇa tu pratyakṣaṃ yogināñcaiva yathā bhavati tacchṛṇu tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥ yāvattrīṇyopaviṣṭāttu tāvatkālaṃ samabhyaset paśyate tasya madhye tu kaṃpamānāṃ varānane prathame kāṃsanīlāntu paśyante yoginassadā ekalakṣaṃ nimīleta tasya lakṣasya paśyatām

taṃ dṛṣṭvā yoginaḥ sākṣāt bhinnadeśe viśecchivam sa eva lakṣamātmānaṃ vidyate paśyateddhruvam evaṃ yogavarasyaiva pratyayaṃ kathayāmi te kaṃpate duḥkhamādeśaṃ kurute yoginaḥ priye vaśyameti śikhā devi yatra kāle tu yoginaḥ avikalpena deveśi paśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ vāyuhaṃsasamāyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhasvarasamanvitam paśyate nātra sandeho bindunādasamanvitam hṛllakṣantu yadā dṛṣṭaṃ yoginena varānane vāyuvarṇāṃ parityajya ū binduśikhayānvitam sarvasvaravinirmukta ra varṇakalasaṃyutam tadā binduvinirmuktaṃ śikhā saṃparikīrtitā vāyavyasya padākhyātāṃ āgneyañcaiva tattathā pañcamaṃ sarvayogasya ādhāraṃ parikīrtitam svayaṃ niṣkramate hyekaṃ tat jñānaṃ sasurāsuraiḥ sarvathā khyāpitaṃ jñānaṃ sarvatantreṣu suvṛte divārātravibhāgantu yasmāddevi pravartate deśikastaṃ vijānāti madhyasthaṃ kamalasthitam trīṇyetāni parityajya sa paraṃ parikīrtitam tatra bhāgavibhāgena śūnyoccāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ tena sidhyati deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā tatkṣaṇāddevi paśyeta prayogamidamuttamam kalāścatasrassaṃ paśyet jvalantaṃ dīpasaṃbhavam madhyadeśe tu yatspṛṣṭamubhayorapi paśyati sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ dhyānayogaphalaṃ śṛṇu

divyādivyañca yatkiñcit sarvaṃ paśyati nānyathā uttiṣṭhe cāntardhāne ca bādalepāñjane tathā etaddevi samākhyātaṃ prayogāmṛtamuttamam anyatantravidā ye tu yuktāyuktavicārakāḥ na tairdevi idaṃ jñānaṃ jñānasadbhāvamuttamam haṃsayogamidaṃ devi kathitaṃ vidhivistarāt trayāṇāṃ devatānāñca darśanaṃ tatra suvṛte punareva pravakṣyāmi yajanaṃ surasundari āsanaṃ praṇavenaiva vidyāṅgaiśca tathaiva ca hṛtpadme sthaṇḍile caiva yaṣṭavyaṃ siddhimicchatā prathame'hani deveśi pratyakṣaṃ pratyayo bhavet yajanājjāyate siddhiḥ jñāne kaivalyatāṃ vrajet īśānamūrdhvato dadyāt pūrvaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ smṛtam sadyojātantu deveśi saṃsthitaṃ paścimena tu nai-ṛtyāntu śikhā devi vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ tathā ekenāvaruṇenaivaṃ yajeta susamāhitā śivena deve deveśi hunetpūrṇāhutiṃ kramāt hṛtpadme yajanañcaiva śṛṇu devi vadāmyaham ṛjurañca tu vijñeyā dharmāpādacatuṣṭayam prathamaṃ kalpayenmūrtiṃ tena sarvamaśeṣataḥ praṇavaṃ nyāsayogena tritatvaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ūkāraṃ paścimenaiva vyomabījottareṇa tu vyābījaṃ vāyudeśe tu bī bījaṃ nai-ṛtena tu tenaiva dhyānakāle tu vinyāsaṃ parikīrtitam sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamañcaiva aṇḍajaṃ svedajaṃ tathā

hiṃsakāstasya duṣṭātmā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cintayedbudhaḥ tān sarvān cintayeddevi duṣṭasatvasya yoginaḥ evañcintitamātrāstu praśamaṃ yānti te śubhe na te hiṃsanti pāpātmā śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā samaṃ yayuḥ śivena samaraso bhūtvā dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ tadeva tatparaṃ brahma sarvabhāvena saṃsthitam sthāvareṣu ca sarveṣu dhīrassarvatra saṃsthitaḥ tadeva tatparaṃ brahma veditavyaṃ hitaiṣibhiḥ evaṃ samaraso bhūtvā viśate śivamavyayam sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ sa tu jo juṣṭabhāṣitam sidhyante nātra sandeho mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ yena vijñātamātreṇa mucyate janmabandhanāt uttānau tu karau kṛtvā veṇībandhantu kārayet avyākārasamāyukto vyomākārasamanvitaḥ kṛñcatau tu śikhā jñeyā pāśacchedakarī nṛṇām viśiṣṭa hṛdayaṃ vidyā piṇḍitaḥ kavacaṃ tathā etadyogaparaṃ devi vikhyātaṃ tava śobhane vedoktavidhinā devi adhyayanaṃ samudāhṛtam carukañca mahādeva dantadhāvanameva ca śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ adhivāsanamuttamam tithinakṣatravārāṇi śākunāni śubhāni tu ādau bhaumaṃ parīkṣeta śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā mahendre malaye sahye ramye puṇyaśilocchaye śmaśāne vā gṛhe vā'pi devagāre tathaiva ca evamādau śubhasthāne yatra vā ramate punaḥ

brāhmaṇānāṃ sitābhūmiḥ raktāvākṣatrayasya tu brāhmaṇe madhurāsvādā kaṣāyā kṣatriyasya tu adya gandhādvije bhūmiḥ kṣatriye raktagandhinī śvānayejjānumātrantu tāṃ samuddhṛtya pūrayet īdṛśīṃ vasudhābhūmiṃ kuryādbhūmi parigraham balistatraiva dātavyā deśikena mahātmanā apare'hani deveśi adhivāsanamārabhet gandhapuṣpasamāyuktaṃ pañcagavyākṣatena ca hutvā tu devadevo'yaṃ mantrāṇāñca yathākramam daśāṃśañcaiva mantrāṇāṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadet pūjayetsarvatatvāni gandhapuṣpavidhikramaiḥ ālabhya sarvamantraistu nyasettatvānyathākramam pāśāni granthiṣairbaddhā vāsayedeva saṃyutam sakalīkṛtya tān sarvān vāyeddevasaṃyutam tāmrapātre śarāvevā ānayejjātavedasam abhyarcya pañcabhiḥ brahmaiḥ tataḥ kuṇḍe tu prakṣipet astreṇa śodhayetkuṇḍa mullikhyābhyukṣya uddharet vāgīśī sthāpayettatra ṛtumatīṃ mahādhipām ekādaśena mantreṇa śivāgnirjānito bhavet śivāgnau janite paścāt agnimāhutimantravit nyastvā tu sarvatantrāṇi tritatvāṃ tatra vinyaset linīvāraśyāmāka yava godhūmapiṇḍakaiḥ yāvatpūrṇā bhavetsthālī kartavyaścarukassadā pañcabhiḥ brahmabhiścaiva atha ekādaśena tu saṃpātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā sarvamantraiḥ sakṛt sakṛt

evaṃ hutvā tu vidhinā tribhāgaṃ kalpayetpunaḥ tṛtīyaṃ sādhakebhyaśca kalpayedvidhipūrvakam gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpi kuśodakam sadyena gomayañcaiva gomūtraṃ guhyakena tu īśānena gṛhetkṣīraṃ gāyatryā tu kuśodakam dātavyaṃ vaktramantreṇa yatkiñcitpānabhojanam avaktrarnirghṛṇañcaiva dvādaśāṅgulasaṃmitam ājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kṛtvā udvāsyotpavanaṃ kuru vaktrābhidhāraṇaṃ kuryāt sadya vāmena buddhimān evaṃ kṛte tu deveśi śivāgnirjanito bhavet āsanaṃ vibhajettatra anantādiranukramāt brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayennityaṃ pūrvadigbhāgato budhaḥ uttare ca nyasennityaṃ śivāya parameśvarī pūjayetpāvamānena viṣṭarasthānyathākramam hemarūpyamayātkuryāt kalaśān ratnapūritān akālamūlakaśān candanenopalepitān ātmatatvamadho bhāge vidyātatvantu madhyataḥ tatratvadṛṣṭyā tu sarvāṇi avalokya mahāmatiḥ vardhanyāmudapūrṇāyāṃ sarvairmantraiḥ sakṛt sakṛt acchinnodakadhārāntu dadyādbāhye tu deśikaḥ astrañca japamānastu ācāryaśca śivātmakaḥ akṣarānvikiritvā tu apūjattena buddhimān kalaśaṃ bhrāmayetpaścāt eṣa eva vidhi smṛtaḥ agnikuṇḍaṃ tato gacchet tato maṇḍalatarpaṇam dantadhāvanamaṅke syāt eṣa eva vidhi smṛtaḥ

indranīlamahānīlā jaja kuryādvidhānavit śāligodhūmavarṇaiśca pratibiṃbe suśobhanaiḥ kathitañcottare sūtre tāni kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ pūjayettatra deveśi pūrvadṛṣṭena karmaṇā patnīsaṃyojanaṃ kuryāt jñānasiddhikramāritam vidyādīkṣā samāptau tu sādhakassavidhīyate abhiṣekañca deveśi pūrvameva udāhṛtam kārikāṃ vā'tha yo vetti abhiṣiktasya dāpayet abhiṣiñcettataḥ śiṣyā nācāryaḥ chinnasaṃśayaḥ nirmāṇakalaśamārabhya aiśvaryañcāpi paścimam pañcāśatkalaśenaiva vidyākhyenābhiṣecayet ānupūrveṇa deveśi ācāryamabhiṣecayet abhiṣikto yadā tena sa guruḥ śivatulyagaḥ pṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā kalaśā ye prakīrtitāḥ navabhiḥ kalaśaiścaiva nava tatvāni vinyaset athavā kalaśekena abhiṣekantu kārayet ekasmin kalaśenaiva vidhireṣo'tra kārayet ucchriyaṃ hastamātrantu kartavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ vitānabudbudaiścaiva vedisthānaṃ suśobhitam svastakaiḥ padmakaiścaiva sandhārthakasamanvitaiḥ śaṅkhabherī ravodghoṣaiḥ stūryaśabdaistathaiva ca kautukaiḥ maṅgalaiścaiva tantrīsaṅgītasaṃyutaiḥ kramaśaścaiva deveśi māyānte parikīrtitam chatrañcopari sandhāya pādau pādukasaṃyutau arghyādibhiḥ samabhyarcya adhikantu samarcayet

kartavyo'nugraho nityaṃ caturāśramavāsinām svalpamahni japaṃ kāryaṃ svalpamagnau ca homayet karaṇīṃ kartarīñcaiva saṃhitāṃ sṛksruvaṃ tathā dīpitaṃ teṣu mantrāṇāṃ bhagavan kathayasva me kathayājñāpayantyete bhagavan vaktumarhasi yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilam ardhacandrantu vijñeyamasmiṃstantre na saṃśayaḥ tena yuktoparisthāna oṃkāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ sā eva varttulībhūtaḥ nakāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ tāstu vakṣyāmi deveśi yathātathena me śṛṇu su sūkṣmā tiryagenaiva ardho dakṣiṇatāṃ gatā agratāmrā caturthī tu bindunādaḥ susaṃyutā sa śivassarvavarṇānāṃ vyāpayitvā varānane tena chinnavibhaktāni padamakṣarasandhayaḥ ṛṣayaśca tathā cānye yogino bhuvimānavāḥ tena jñāpayate sarvaṃ mantragrāmamaśeṣataḥ śivatatvaṃ pare śuddhaṃ sa bāhyābhyantare sthitam tena te preritā mantrāḥ śaktayaśca na saṃśayaḥ oṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ niyojayet svāhākāraṃ vaṣaṭkāraṃ suvauṣaṭkārameva ca etatra śaktisaṃyogaṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ svāhākārasamāyukto homeṣvākarṣaṇeṣu ca puṣṭyarthe ca sadā kuryāt sakārokārasaṃyutam ṣakāramantrayogena hakārasahitena tu amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt vaṣaṭkārasamanvitaḥ

praṇavena yadā hīnaṃ mantragrāmamaśeṣataḥ ānayejjapadaityādi vratajaptaśucissadā uccāṭayati bhūtāni divyabhūmigatāni tu māraṇe tu vidhiṃ kuryāt śeṣāssarve namo yutāḥ homakāle'tha śuddhirjapayoge ca sarvadā ekānnanirato nityamupavāsarato'pi vā kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairvā'pi japakāle sadā bhavet anyathā naiva siddhyanti vṛ * kṣaśnānti sādhakāḥ tathā te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā mama tristhānakāla tatvajñaḥ śivaśaktiparāyaṇaḥ akṣarākṣatasandhāna na drutaṃ na vilaṃbitam plutaṃ visargasaṃyuktaṃ svayayuktaṃ mayoditaḥ śrīparṇyabhiṣeke cāpi kṛtvā tu rucirāsanam ebhirāsanamukhyaistu vistīrṇaistu samāhitaiḥ padāduccuko bhūtvā homayedbhuvi deśikaḥ vedanārto yadā mantrī na lakṣaṃ vindate sadā urastaṃbho mahāghoraḥ pārśve rogastathaiva ca roge tu yujyamāne tu yathā kuryāttu deśikaḥ nāvyāhāreṇa kartavyo yogāraṃbhaḥ kadācana nivātaśaraṇe divye tasmiṃsthitvā samabhyaset sa vikalpasya yogastu kathitastava śobhane tathā tu śṛṇu deveśi kathayāmi samāsataḥ tṛṣārte jāyate doṣaḥ bhittakṣobhoti dāruṇaḥ kaṃpamānañca pittañca piṭakādyagnisaṃbhavāt kṣudhārtasya tṛṣārtasya paśukā saha suvṛte

navamantrapadasyaiva kṣudhayā vyākulīkṛtaḥ haviṣya bhojanaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtakṣīraparipluta pūrṇāhutyā prapātantu utsṛṣṭistu na kārayet dahyamāno yadā mantrī prāyaścittamavāpnuyāt nā sādhayanti karmāṇi tasmāttaṃ parivarjayet tena deṣo bhavoddevi tasmāttaṃ parivarjayet eteṣu dahyamāneṣu prāyaścittārthamādarāt dhyātvā tatvaṃ viśuddhyeta prāyaścittāni saṃśayam pādāṅguṣṭhau samau kṛtvā prasṛtena tu deśikaḥ pātro na dahyate devi tathāpatā tu āhutiḥ pūrvoktena vidhānena śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ nyāsastu kathito deva samayācāradhāritaḥ ātmadehe tu jñātavyā bhagavan vaktumarhasi yena vijñānamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ dakṣiṇe yojayedbījaṃ vāme yonintu vinyaset varge varge tu kartavyaṃ mantro vai deśikena tu punarnavamamuccārya śabdātītantu kārayet akāro pratijñeyā nābhyadhastāttu vinyaset patreṣu vinyaseddevi niyatiṃ tadanantaram śivatatvantu deveśi sarveṣāmupari sthitam bindunādaṃ tathā śaktiḥ evaṃ vinyasya yatnataḥ sūryamaṇḍalavinyāsamādāveva vicintayet brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca tathāceśvara eva ca nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva ca sūkṣmā nāma kalā yā tu su sūkṣmā ca dvitīyakā

asya pañca ca deveśi vinyasecchaktivatsadā tattvayā viditaṃ devi kimanyatkathayāmi te viditaṃ tattvayā devi vā?sti tatvamataḥ param navātmakaṃ nyasetpūrvaṃ bhinnaikaikaṃ na saṃśayaḥ sakalaṃ dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhe śeṣaṃ pūrvaṃ samācaret tritatvaṃ pūrvaṃ vinyasya śivaṃ paścāttu vinyaset tena sarvamidaṃ kāryamarcanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tathā prathamaṃ karavinyāsaṃ na cāsmānaṃ prakīrtitam navātmānaṃ tṛtīyantu tadbhinnantu caturthakam trayodaśaṃ paraṃ devi sarvavyādhi vyavasthitam trayodaśātmasānnidhyaṃ yadi syāttatvavedinaḥ vacasā kurute dīkṣāṃ cakṣuṣā ca na saṃśayaḥ darśanātpūrvatejantu vacasā ca na saṃśayaḥ nyāse kṛte tu deveśi samarthassarvakarmasu eko'pi yo vijānāti mucyate ca na saṃśayaḥ na lipyate puṇyapāpaiḥ svācāryasyāpi mocakaḥ ācāryāya tu dātavyamabhiṣiktāya dhīmate sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ jñātavyaṃ deśikena tu mucyante darśanāttasya ācāryasya na saṃśayaḥ vapurdarśanamātreṇa mantrāṇāṃ sravaṇena tu agniśabdena suśroṇipāśaśabdena caiva hi vapuḥ saṃdarśanāddevi deśikasya mahātmanaḥ mantrāṇāṃ śravaṇenaiva śṛṇu devi vadāmyaham dhūmasaṃdarśanāddevi viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt vidyātatve tu yā vyaktiḥ bhavate pāpakarmaṇā

etatte kathitaṃ devi śivasyāsaṃ mahatphalam anena dīkṣitā martyāḥ paśavo muktabandhanāḥ ato mantravibhāgantu kathayāmi varānane aṅguṣṭhamāditaḥ kṛtvā pañcabrahmāṇi vinyaset rudroṅkārasamāyuktaḥ phaṭkāreṇa samanvitaḥ prāsādabhūmiṃ saṃśodhya sarvametena kārayet sarvametena kartavyaṃ yatkiñcicchodhanāya vai pañcamaṃ vinyasecchaktiṃ śivaśaktikalāṃ nyaset śivahastaṃ yadā dadyāt deśikastu mahātmanā mātṛkā homakāle tu śṛṇu vakṣyāmi suvṛte agnisaṃskārapūrvantu kṛtvā tu varavarṇinī vilomena punaścāpi juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ anulomavilomena hotavyaṃ deśikena tu mantrāṇāñcaiva vinyāsaḥ kathitastava śobhane etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tava devi varānane pañcāṅgena samāyuktamekahastaṃ surottame aṣṭapatraṃ nyasetpadmaṃ kesarālaṃ sa karṇikam āgneyyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasyaṃ īśānyāntu śironyaset caturdikṣu nyasedastrameṣa eva vidhismṛtaḥ āvāhantu kartavyaṃ hṛdayena visarjanam astreṇa śodhayedbhūmiṃ eṣa eva vidhismṛtaḥ maṇḍale tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā daśadikṣu baliṃ haret tena te tṛptimāyānti bhūtagrāmamaśeṣataḥ tato bhūtāni tuṣyanti śivena balinā sadā

pāyasaṃ kṛsarañcaiva hāridrañca guḍodanam ṣaḍvidheṣa balirdevi mayā te parikīrtitaḥ evaṃ gaṇapateryāgo mayā te parikīrtitaḥ gaṇayāgantu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhuparigraham pañcamantu samākhyātaṃ caṇḍeśāya mahātmane ṣaḍvidhaṃ yajate yastu ācāryaḥ susamāhitaḥ mantrasoccāravinyāsaṃ sthānāni anupūrvaśaḥ punaśca śrotumicchāmi saṃśayo me maheśvara rūpahīnā na sidhyanti devadaityendrarākṣasāḥ bhūtaiśca paribhūyante niveśaṃ yānti pannagāḥ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva amṛtīkaraṇāni ca tasmādrūpaṃ mahādeva mantrāṇāṃ kathayasva me kalānāṃ rūpamākhyā hi phalanyāsasya yadbhavet sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe yattvayā coditosmyaham etatpṛśnaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ aśeṣaphalabhūmidam prāṇāyāmaparo bhūtvā rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyutam saptaraśmipratīkāśaṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam candrāṃśunirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ vidyutkoṭisamaprabham bījaṃ sañcintayeddevi sarvakilviṣanāśanam yogamutpadyate devi māsānabhyantareṇa tu caṇḍaraśmipratīkāśaṃ dyotayantaṃ samantataḥ candracandrakasaṃkāśaṃ yonicakraṃ vicintayet dhyātavyaṃ yogibhirnityaṃ dyotayantaṃ samantataḥ ekībhūtāni sañcitya yugāntakiraṇatviṣaḥ navātmānaṃ varārohe jñātavyantu sadāśivaḥ

piṇḍībhūtāśśirasthāne bindureko vicintyatā tasyātite sthitā śaktiḥ dyotayantī samantataḥ śaktistu devadeveśi tvameva parikīrtitā sāṃpṛtaṃ śṛṇu devyatra tatvānāṃ kathayāmi te kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ tathā śvetaṃ dhyātavyaṃ yogibhissadā yakāraṃ pauruṣaṃ tatvaṃ śivarūpaṃ vicintayet etaddhyānaparo bhūtvā yogasiddhimavāpnuyāt ayaṃ vā śuklakṛṣṇañca raktasūtreṇa coditaḥ sidhyate nātra sandehaḥ satyaṃ devi vadāmyaham dyotayantaṃ svakaṃ sthānaṃ dhyātavyaṃ śuddhimicchatā dyotayantaṃ svakaṃ sthānaṃ dhyātvā siddhirna saṃśayaḥ sidhyate hyavicāreṇa sādhakassusamāhitaḥ īśvarastu rakāro vai citrarūpa udāhṛtaḥ sidhyate hyavicāreṇa evaṃ nyāsaṃ vicintayet dhyātavyaṃ yogibhirnityaṃ yugāntakiraṇatviṣā anena siddhyate yogī sarvajñatvaṃ pravartate kathitaṃ sa rahasyantu na mayā gopitaṃ tava śuklapadmopariṣṭhāttu śobhayantī mahāyaśāḥ evaṃ rūpadharī dhyātvā vinyasetpādayordharām ācāryaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathaiva vasudhā bhavet vāyuñjānupradeśe tu pītavarṇaṃ vicintayet ākāśaṃ bhuviraṃ rūpaṃ dhyātavyaṃ yogibhissadā ahaṅkāraṃ tathā raktaṃ guhye cātmani vinyaset kuṅkumāruṇasaṅkāśaṃ caturvaktraṃ caturbhujam nyāsakāle tu deveśi buddhimevaṃ vidhaṃ nyaset

te tvayā viditā devi kalānāṃ śṛṇu sāṃpṛtam dyotayantī samantāttu raśmibhirhimaśītalaiḥ nyāsakāle tu dhyātavyā yogamutpadyate sadā dyotayantī varārohe nyāsakāle vicintayet candrātapapratīkāśāṃ muñcantīmamṛtaṃ sadā su sūkṣmā hṛdayaṃ yāvat dhyātavyā nityameva hi amṛtākarṇamāśritya anekakiraṇojvalā amṛtāmṛtakalā yā tu anaupamyā hyanāmayā mṛtyuñjayeṣibhirdivyā dhyātavyā nityameva hi karṇike devatānyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ siddhimicchatā kṣuṣā hi deveśi veditavyāni deśikaiḥ hṛdi padmasya vinyāsaṃ śṛṇu devi vadāmyaham dharmapādo bhavetchuklo jñānaṃ raktaṃ vicintayet gātrakāṇi tathaiveha chadanāni tathaiva ca evaṃ padmasya vinyāsaṃ yāgakāle vicintayet tattanyāse tu te devi tatastatvaṃ vicintayet tasya tejasmṛtāssarve ye kecit samudāhṛtāḥ ekaike tu kṛte nyāse ekaikaṃ tena bhāṣayet mantrāstathaiva jñātavyā kalāścaiva samantataḥ uccāṭe māraṇe caiva tāḍane'pi varānane bhrukuṭīkarālavadanā krūrakarmasuyojayet kṛśayantīṃ sadā devi cintayenmantradevatām pāṣāṇadhāriṇīñcaiva kāṣṭhahastāṃstathaiva ca māraṇoccāraṇādīni kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ saumyāṃ śuklīṃ mahādevi śvetapadme vyavasthitām

candrāṃśudhavalassaumyāḥ prāsādaṃ savyapāṇinā vaśīkaraṇa ākarṣe pāśamaṅkuśadhāriṇīm staṃbhane kṛṣṇavarṇāntu nityameva vicintayet eṣa devi samākhyāto nyāsaḥ paramadurlabhaḥ evaṃ nyāsa iha proktaḥ sarvamantreṣu cottamaḥ abhojya bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā hatvā lokaṃ carācaram suvarṇasteyagodānaṃ hutvā bahutarāṇi ca evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā ācāryassusamāhitaḥ kālayāgavidhānena deśiko yajate yadi ekāhamapi mayā nyāsaṃ kurute sādhakottamaḥ saptāhamabhyasedyastu imaṃ nyāsaṃ samāhitaḥ māsādutpadyate yogaḥ trisandhyaṃ yastu cintayet sarvaṃ saṃpādayatyeṣa lokasyaiva hitāhitam trailokyasya tu vṛttāntaṃ kathayennātra saṃśayaḥ gacchate nātra sandehaḥ sādhakassusamāhitaḥ siddhyate nātra sandehaḥ yoginastu na saṃśayaḥ ākāśagamanañcaiva daṇḍakāṣṭhapavitrakam jñātvā nyāsamidaṃ devi vinyāsamanyatpalālavat ātmāhyatraiva jñātavyo devāścaiva viśeṣataḥ sādhakasya ca dātavyamācāryasya tathaiva ca pañcabrahmeśavāṅgānāṃ rūpāṇi kathayasva me pañcabrahma śivāṅgānāṃ sāmānyaṃ parameśvari navasūtre purā proktaḥ rūpāstā eva śobhane hṛdayasya pravakṣyāmi rūpaṃ śṛṇu sulocane dyotayantaṃ hyadhaścordhvaṃ hṛtpradeśe vyavasthitam

śiranyāsaṃ śiro devi hārakundendusannibham indukoṭipratīkāśaṃ śikhāṃ deviṃ vicintayet tena nyāsena dhyānena sādhakassusamāhitaḥ kavacaṃ sarvagātreṣu sūryakoṭisamaprabham nyāsena sidhyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā trāsayantaṃ mahādevi vighnāścaiva vicintayet paścāttu sādhanaṃ kuryāt nivighnaiḥ siddhimāpnuyāt astramadhye japaṃ kuryāt tadā sidhyati nānyathā tatra pāśupataṃ hastraṃ śivāṅgaṃ ghorasaṃjñitam tadā nirvighnato devi sidhyate sādhakottamaḥ tadā nirvighnamāyāti sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ kṛtvā pañcaravatyogaṃ madhye tu japamārabhet pramāṇaṃ japitaṃ mantraṃ punareva tu suvṛte tadā siddhimavāpnoti devyā mānuṣakṛtrimāḥ sarvakarmakaraḥ śrīmān karmaṇā manasā girā yogasiddhimavāpnoti mantrāssiddhyanti nānyathā naṣṭañca kathayeddevi śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca guruṃ jñātvā mahādevi kalpate nātra saṃśayaḥ yasmin sthāne tu te śodhyāḥ ekadikkāmavedituḥ tathā te kathayiṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu pañca pañca suvaiyojyā deśikena mahātmanā evamatvaṃ tathā tejo āśuge vai tathaiva ca karmendriyacarusthañca śrotrajñānendriyaṃ smṛtam śāktau śivaṃ tathaiveha ekaikaṃ kramaśastathā ahaṅkārastathā ṣaṣṭho anulomādviśodhayet

kalānāṃ nirṇayañcaiva tatvānāṃ nirṇayastathā jñātvā bhaktimayaṃ śiṣyaṃ dīkṣāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi niṣkalaṃ śrotumicchāmi sakalaṃ vyāpya viṣṭhitam yena muktassadharmātmā dharmotsanno nigadyate ameyassarvagaśśuddhaḥ sarvaśaktikalānvitaḥ ekāntāvasthito hyeṣaḥ śivaśaktisamanvitaḥ jagatkṛtsnaṃ mahāyogaṃ śaktiyogaṃ marīcibhiḥ śāntatvāt svakartṛtvāt śaktimatvānmahaujasaḥ prakurvanti jagatkṛtsnaṃ śaktayastā mahātmanaḥ sarvākāramanākāramanaupamyamanāmayam mantratejomayonityamacintyaḥ paramaśśivaḥ vāgviśuddhaḥ parajyotiḥ svatejo dṛḍhagocaraḥ susūkṣmamavyayannityaṃ kāraṇaṃ jyotiruttamam vidyutparārdhakoṭīnāṃ tattejo vyāpya tiṣṭhati tejasā tasya dīpyante mahātejāśca sa smṛtaḥ evaṃ vrataḥ paro devaḥ sa tejastejasāmapi nirmalādarśakaprakhyaṃ śaradvārisamaprabham atyantanaṣṭatamasā ūrdhvabhāsā diśo daśa nityaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam sarvabhūtātma bhūtastha paraṃ vyomaśivo'vyayaḥ niścitya kartṛkartā ca sarvabhūtapatiśśivaḥ sarve śuddhāśca nityāśca ye sthitāśśivagocare pṛthagrūpantu yatproktaṃ sādhakaiḥ śāstracintakaiḥ mahādyutirmahābhūtiḥ mahātejā mahāyaśāḥ agrāhyaṃ sarvabhūtasthamakṣobhyañcāvyayaṃ tathā

ātmasaṃsthañca vijñeyamarūpañcāpratiṣṭhitam ajañcānantarūpañca agotrapitṛmātṛkam anādimadhyanidhanamacālyamacalaṃ dhruvam samañca sarvabhūteṣu satataṃ vitatantanum nirmalaṃ nirahaṅkāraṃ nirbuddhiñca nirindriyam nityodayaṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirāmayam na nimnaṃ nodhritañcaiva na vakranna ca vā ṛjuḥ na trikoṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ na caiva parimaṇḍalam na parokṣaṃ samakṣañca na gatirna ca vā gatiḥ na cāsti na ca vā nāsti sarvasthaṃ kimavīṣṭhitam na paraṃ pratyayaṃ vedyannāparaṃ kiñciducyate na tatra jāyate sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhāro naiva jāyate avyayañca dhruvannityamanaupamyamanāmayam sadā śāntaṃ sunirvāṇaṃ paritṛptañca sarvataḥ abhojyañcāpyabhuktañca svacchañcaiva sunirmalam dharmādharmaguṇaihīnaṃ saṃśritaṃ na ca kenacit virajaṃ cārajaṃ śuddhaṃ śivadharma paviśca yat dūṣaṇādoṣarahitaṃ na calaṃ nāvacālitam anantanahanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇātītalakṣaṇam sarvakāraṇadharmañca kāraṇātītalakṣaṇam na ca tacchakyate jñātuṃ vinā tasyāpyanugrahāt guruvaktrāttu labhyeta tacchaktyā saṃpracoditāt yaḥ prapadyedidaṃ sarvaṃ jñātaṃ tenāpi sarvataḥ tadīryatenātra bhedena manasā tu manonmanau aśuddhaṃ śuddhatatvantu vyomāmṛtapadodbhavaḥ

svaprakāśaparaṃ vedyaṃ na kenāpi prakāśate tathā'sau paramo devaḥ svaśaktraivāvalokate sarvadoṣavinirmuktamasāmānyaguṇodayaḥ kopaprasādarahitaḥ prabhuranya īśaḥ mahāmālañjanājālavyatītatanurīśvaraḥ na vidyante yatastasya śāntaṃ śivapadaṃ tataḥ śivatvaṃ gīyate śaṃbhoḥ sadā saumyaṃ mahātmanaḥ sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ nityaṃ śubhakaraṃ śivam jagadgurussavijñeyaḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥ nissahatvajaṭādhāraḥ śivacandrakirīṭavān nirāvaraṇamannatvaṃ trailokyaṃ divyacakṣuṣaḥ acalaśśāśvato vyāpī ajonityasvayaṃbhuvaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ anakṣaramanutpādyamanirdeśyamanāmayam sākṣivatsaṃsthito nityaṃ triprakārasya karmaṇaḥ yasya yasya manaśceṣṭā śubhe vā yadi vā'śubhe kṣaṇaṃ yatpaśyate sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ hitāhitam sarvamātmani paśyeta na ca saṃyujyate vibhuḥ śṛṇute manute nityaṃ na tu yujyati sarvataḥ śrotā vaktā ca bhoktā ca mantā ca sukhaduḥkhayoḥ aśeṣabhuvanavyāpī niśśeṣo bandhamokṣakṛt anādimadhyanidhanaḥ prabhavaḥ sarvatatvagaḥ sarvajñaśca prabuddhaśca prakako bodhakastathā utpādakohyanutpādya āśāsyaḥ śāsitā tathā icchayā sakalo deva icchayā kalavarjitaḥ

pravṛttasya virodhīte vināśotpattikāraṇam sarvasaṃbhavahetuścāpyahetuśca sanātanaḥ sarvakāraṇadharmaśca śaktibhiḥ pravibhāvyate anādikhyayaścaiva avicālyo vicālakaḥ śaktibhiścāprameyaśca tṛptaśca bhagavān śivaḥ atarkyaceṣṭito devaḥ prabhuḥ prabhavatāmapi sa tasmāt jñānamātreṇa niṣṭhīve hi sa preritaḥ prerako niṣkalo hyeṣa yathā sakalaniṣkalaḥ śaktirādyātivimalā śaktibhinnā nivāryate bhaveti śaktijihvatvaṃ pradīpyantaṃ nivāryate kṛtaprasādanopāya lakṣaṇaṃ gīryate prabhoḥ phalānāñca tathā śeṣāṃ patanañca yathā niśam ayaskāntagatāśaktiramūrtā kurute kriyāḥ śaktayaśśaṅkaravaśādvartantetyantanirmalāḥ na karoti svayaṃ yasmāt śāntastena nigadyate yathā kṛṣīvalāhīnāṃ svakarmāṇyanuvartinām evaṃ sarvāṇi karmāṇi japadhyānāni kānicit atītassarvabhāvānāṃ acintyaguṇavarjitaḥ na cāsau cendriyagrāhyo na kareṇa na cakṣuṣā pūrayatī niravaśeṣaṃ samastatanurīśvaropyatanuḥ adhitiṣṭhati bhūtāni gūḍhaśśabdādivarjitaḥ otaprotamanādyantaṃ śaktibhirvyāpya saṃsthitaḥ sarvataḥ sarvabhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca agre prakāśayedyasmāt agre śivavācchivādhvare sarvāntassamādhistha antaḥkaraṇagocaraḥ

sarvātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtavivarjitaḥ pradhānaguṇasaṃhartā tatvaṃ mayā varaṃ smṛtam sarvabhūtātmasaṃsthānaṃ sarvatra gatamavyayam evaṃ paramanirvāṇa svamāyī paramaśśivaḥ eṣa duḥkhātigo hetureṣa kṣemakaraśśivaḥ śivassadākāraṇakāraṇāntaraḥ sa nirvāṇaḥ paraśśuddho nirmāyī paramaśśivaḥ anudhyānena tannityaṃ smarantī manasā dhiyaḥ niśvāse tu pare tantre niṣkalassakalasya tu deyaṃ śaivābhiṣiktāya na dadyātparadīkṣite sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca prasādī bhava me prabho kathayasva mahādeva mantracāraṃ mama prabho brahmaṇāñcaiva deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ kaleṣu kriyatī saṃkhyā prabhuḥ kirati sāṅkuraḥ daśātmamāditaḥ kṛtvā tasyāṅgānāṃ yathākramam padeṣu kiyatī saṃkhyā prabhuścarati nityaśaḥ kathañcarati deveśa kathayasva ca śaṅkara śṛṇu devi mahājñānaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchritam sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ mantracāramanukramāt mantracāraṃ mahādevi durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi kathayāmi na saṃdigdhaṃ prāṇena saha suvṛte ṣaṭ śatena tathā proktā prāṇasaṃkhyā yathākramam padaistu yāvatī prāṇāḥ ekaikasya vibhāgaśaḥ ekaikasya tu varṇasya yā saṃkhyā vahatīśvare etadbhedavidhānajño bhinna dehassa ucyate

yena yena hi mantreṇa karaṇaṃ kurute naraḥ sa evaṃ mantramātmānaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ tanmadhyena tu mantrajño mocayenmucyateti ca tena tena kalenaiva mocayettatvavidguruḥ tena yaṣṭe hute caiva sidhyate mucyate'pi ca tena yaṣṭe hute caiva sidhyate mucyate'pi ca jñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa dīkṣāyogajapaṃ kuru hrasvadīrghāstu ye varṇāḥ svarayuktāstu ye smṛtāḥ praṇavoddhārabhedena jñātvā'traiva padāni tu homaṃ pūrvoditasteṣāṃ kartavyo deśikena tu kalāpatreṣu saṃsthāpya mantrakarṇikayā nyaset kartavyā deśikendreṇa siddhikāmena bhāminī evaṃ pūjya yathā nyāyaṃ dīkṣāṃ kurvīta deśikaḥ veditavyaṃ prayatnena sādhakairmokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ yajjñātvā mucyate'vaśyaṃ bhavasaṃsārabandhanāt pūrvādārabhya vijñeyamekaikasya yathākramam kathayāmi na saṃdigdhaṃ aśeṣantu tavānaghe prāṇāśśatadvayaṃ jñeyāḥ prāṇatiṣṭhatastathaiva ca lavamekattṛṭistṛṃśat jñātavyaṃ surasundari ahorātreṇa deveśi jñātavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ vyomavyāpini varṇānāṃ prāṇā vai ṣaṣṭi kīrtitāḥ tṛṭistu pañcabhūtānāṃ ekaikasya varānane kathitaṃ tava deveśi padavarṇeṣu śobhane sadyasya vāmadevasya aghorasya tathaiva ca sadyaḥ kalābhiraṣṭābhiḥ ekaike tu yathā bhavet

sahasradvayasaṃyuktaṃ tathā saptaśatāni ca aghore tāvatī jñeyā deśikena mahātmanā sahasrārdhasamāścaiva tathā ṣaṭtṛṃśatāni ca prāṇa ekassamākhyāto lavamekaṃ tathaiva ca puruṣasya pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥ etaddevi samākhyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ tatvavedinā sahasrāstu samākhyātāḥ catvāro varavarṇinī ekaikasya tu brahmasya kalā vai yāvatī smṛtā kalācāraṃ samākhyātaṃ saṃkṣepānna tu vistarāt śivāṅgān saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priye sarvātmeti samākhyātaṃ hṛdayaṃ paramātmanaḥ suśivo'ṣṭākṣaraḥ proktaḥ tasya pāraṃ śṛṇu priye śatāni sapta vijñeyāḥ jñātavyaṃ deśikena tu jvālinyāḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥ prāṇaṣaṣṭiśca vijñeyāḥ trayaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca tṛṭiviśvasamāyukto ekaikasya varānane piṅgalasya pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu etasmin devadeveśi prabhuścarati nityaśaḥ astrendrasya pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥ śatāni pañcasaṃkhyāni prāṇānāṃ surasundari tṛṭiścaturthabhāgañca prabhuścarati nityaśaḥ etaddevi samākhyātaṃ śivapīṭhe tu ye sthitāḥ abhinnāḥ śivasaṃyuktāḥ mantrā vidyoditapradāḥ śivasyāsanamāsthānamantrāḥ sarvajñakīrtitāḥ padavarṇavibhedena kalābhedena ye sthitāḥ

ekaikantu padā mantraṃ japate sādhako yadi mātṛkāyāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvaśāstrasusaṃyutam tasmātsarvaprayatnena mātṛkācāramabhyaset akārādikṣakārāntā mātṛkā parikīrtitāḥ ekaikasya tu varṇasya śatāni catureva tu tṛṭirekā tu vijñeyā sādhakena mahātmanā abhinnaṃ yajate yastu tasya cāro na vidyate daśātmadehaṃ vakṣyāmi tadekāgramanā śṛṇu prāṇāṣṣaṣṭistathaiveha ekaikasya varānane abhinneṣu varārohe bhavennityoditaḥ prabhuḥ sahasratritayaṃ jñeyamekaikasya varānane dvayamekañca deveśi tṛṭirekā prakīrtitā hṛdayastu samākhyātaḥ śirasaḥ kathayāmi te saṃkhyā vai tāvatī proktā śirasastu na saṃśayaḥ netrasyaiva pravakṣyāmi cāraṃ śṛṇu sulocane etaccāraṃ samākhyātaṃ ekaikasya varānane varṇasthaṃ kathitaṃ devi bhinnacārakathā bhavet sonādikastu bhagavān anākhyeyaṃ hyanāmayam pīṭhaṃ ta sa tu deveśi kathitañcānupūrvaśa samudāyena mantrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane saṃvatsaratanurdevo yadi syādbhajane guruḥ ṣaḍvarṇaṃ yajate mantrī tasyaiva japamārabhet bhinnāvasthaṃ tridhā kṛtvā na bhūyo janmabhāk bhavet utpattipralayaṃ jñātvā sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi

tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvatpriyārthaṃ varānane etat jñānapadaṃ divyaṃ sa devāsuramānuṣam etatsūtakamityāhuḥ sarvaprāṇiṣu vartate dvāvetau tyajate yastu sa bhavettatvapāragaḥ mṛtakaṃ yo na jānāti sūtakañca svadehataḥ bhoktavyaṃ sarvato devi tyakte mṛtakasūtake sūtakaṃ dehamadhyasthaṃ mṛtakañca tathaiva ca utpattipralayaścaiva bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim bhagavan śrotumicchāmi prāṇināñca hitāhitam kati prāṇāsmṛtā deva abde tu kathayasva me kathaṃ dīrghāyuṣañcaiva kathaṃ strībālayorapi śṛṇu devi parapraśnaḥ tvayā devi udāhṛtaḥ mayā pūrvaṃ samākhyātaṃ tvayā'pi viditaṃ tathā varṣe varṣe yāvatī prāṇā māse pakṣe tathaiva ca gaṇitaṃ gaṇitairdevi prameyaparimāṇataḥ ahorātreṇa jñātavyo kālajñena mahātmanā ete prāṇā mayā proktā śatabhāgavibhājitāḥ śatadvayañca vijñeyaṃ prāṇānāṃ varavarṇinī tṛṭiraṣṭau tu vijñeyā aho jīvasya suvṛte na na prāṇā smṛtaḥ pakṣo māsastadviguṇena ca anena ahamukhyena jñātavyaṃ tatvavedinā prahare prahare caiva varṣāhyatra trayodaśa anena kramayogena veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ na kenacidahaṃ pṛṣṭo na mayā kathitaṃ kvacit bhāskaravyodaye jātaṃ bālakaṃ kaścamī diśet

pañca ṣaṭ saptamāṣṭau ca yāvadvādaśakordhvataḥ yāvadvarṣā bhavedyūnāṃ tāvadāyurvinirdiśet prāṇasaṃkhyaistu deveśi ye śavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ prameyaprāṇavarṣā ye mūrtibāle tamādiśet evaṃ krameṇa deveśi jñātavyaṃ tatvavedinā evañcaturthamādeśaṃ kṛtvā devi samādiśet evaṃ dhyānaparo bhūtvā yogī vai susamāhitaḥ yo vegini bilenaiva devatāramitaṃ śubham dhānādhivahane caiva nārī tyevaṃ samādiśet prathame viṣuve lagne puruṣasmṛtajātakaḥ yadācāravibhāge tu avidhajñāstu yogavit catuṣṣaṣṭi smṛtā marma dehināṃ dehamuttamam yāni kāni tathā cānye jñātavyāni yathākramam autpādakoni yāni syuḥ kathayāmi samāsataḥ sīdanti sarvāṇyaṅgāni dāhaḥ śoṣaḥ kṣayo bhavet nāḍīsañcāratatvajño lakṣabhedā kṛtaśramaḥ mṛtyuñjayādibhiryogaiḥ punastāḥ samaye budhaḥ yasmin yasmin bhavetsvedaḥ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te bāhusandhistritīyā tu stanābhyāntu caturthakam kaṇṭhasyaivopariṣṭhāttu ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai parikīrtitam jānusandhirmahāmarma cāṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitam hṛdaye tu mahāmarma devi te samudāhṛtaḥ ādhyātmikāni yāni syuḥ tāni vakṣyāmi te śṛṇu tadā devi vijānīyāt sadyo mṛtyumupasthitaḥ na paśyati raso jihve ṣaṇmāsamadhikaṃ punaḥ

yo naraṃ vahate caiva marmastāvattatasmṛtaḥ teṣāṃ vai sannirodhena marmaṇāñcaiva sundari ayātmādātmanaḥ paśyedyadi syāttatvavedinaḥ tadā tu praśamaṃ yānti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā veditavyaṃ prayatnena na dadyādyasya kasyacit kathaṃ saṃhārakāle tu veditavyaṃ hi yogibhiḥ etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi yena vijñātamātreṇa cārajño nāvasīdati jñātvā śreyāṃsi kurvīta tadā'sau nāvasīdati tadā prabhṛti kartavyā kālasyaiva pratikriyā tatra jñātvā punassamyagyathā mṛtyuñjayo bhavet mṛtasañjīvanañcaiva kathayiṣye yathā bhavet tathā yena prakāreṇa rodhitena tu lakṣaṇam maṇibandhena śūnyena śṛṇu tasyaiva lakṣaṇam tilako dahyate yasya saṃhṛtaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet māsaikādaśabhiścaiva mṛtyumabhyeti suvṛte muhurmuhuḥ prakaṃpaśca saṃhṛtaṃ taṃ vinikṣipet śaṅkhau tu hīyamānau tu śṛṇu vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam niruddhaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt pratyakṣañcaiva dṛśyate kaṇṭhanāḍyupariṣṭāttu staṃbhite lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu śoṣitastu varārohe saptamāsānna jīvati kaṇṭhaśoṣaṃ bhavettīvraṃ niśleṣmaṃ kā samāvahet evaṃ vai lakṣaṇaṃ yasya caturmāsān sa jīvati raktavarṇaṃ bhavenmūtraṃ dahatī ca na saṃśayaḥ muṣkasūtrapradeśe tu yasyaivaṃ śūlamāvahet

evaṃ lakṣaṇato budhvā dvau māsau sa tu jīvati gate dakṣiṇato devi jīvenmāsaṃ sa pakṣakam māsamekaṃ na jīveta iti śāstreṣu niścitam staṃbhitaṃ taṃ vijānīyādardhamāsaṃ sa jīvati tato'sau mṛtyumabhyeti divasairdaśabhistathā tasya mṛtyuṃ vijānīyāt pañcāhāttu na saṃśayaḥ visvaraścaiva jāyeta hīnāyuṣoji bhāminī cakṣuṣī naiva dṛśyeta pūrvadṛṣṭañca rūpakam gulphadeśe yadā spandaṃ niṣpandaṃ bhavate yadi hṛdayaṃ vepate yasya mūrchākaṃpaśca jāyate kaṇṭhe guḍuguḍoyetatkiñcitspandati suvṛte tālumadhye gato vāyuḥ kiñcitspandati suvṛte evaṃ marmavibhāgajñaḥ sādhako nāvasīdati ekādaśa śatañcāṣṭau nava sapta tathaiva ca māsaṃ sa pakṣakañcaiva māsaṃ māsārdhameva ca aharekaṃ vijānīyāddinārdhaṃ praharaṃ tathā maṇibandhāditaḥ kṛtvā veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ pavitrāṇi japahomakriyāstathā etairmāyā mayā proktāḥ yathāsaṃkhyena suvṛte samena savyamarmāṇāṃ yadi niṣpandatā bhavet śleṣmaṇā caiva deveśi niṣpandaṃ yānti te punaḥ anyadguhyatamaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te iḍā suṣamnayoścāraṃ jñātavyaṃ yogibhissadā ātmanaśca vijānāti yathākālaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ utpātaṃ kiñcidākhyāti na tatra bhayamādiśet

gotrasyācāśubhaṃ vidyānna mṛtyuṃ tasya cādiśet mahadbhayaṃ bhaveddevi grāmagotrasya suvṛte ātmanastvaśubhaṃ vidyānmahākleśena jīvati ātmano mṛtyurāyāti iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ rājñaścaivāśubhaṃ vidyādājyena ca viyujyate vāhanānāṃ kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kathayecchivayogavit rājñāṃ caiva bhayaṃ vidyānmahākleśena jīvati rājānamaśubhaṃ vidyānmahākleśena jīvati rājñāṃ maraṇamāśusyādyadi vai vinivartate janānāmaśubhaṃ vidyādyāvatpañca daśe'hani evaṃ jñātvā tu medhāvīṃ na sīdennaiva yogavit etaddevi samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamam cāreṇa jñāyate * * kārayoge na saṃśayaḥ nissate kiṃ pramāṇa syāt praviśepi maheśvara mahatpuṇyamidaṃ devi na pṛṣṭaṃ kenacitpurā prāṇasyaiva nirodhena sthātavyaṃ deśikena tu tāvattakṣaṇamātreṇa sa siddhenaiva sādhakaḥ yadā prāṇanirodhastu bhavate sādhakasya tu ūrdhvabhāge care yāvadadhaśśūnyaṃ vinirdiśet utkarṣaṇī kalā sūkṣmā su sūtre ca dvitīyakā ūrdhvaṃ sañcaratastasya kale dakṣiṇataḥ sthite adhomukhe prayātasya kale dve vāmatasthite yāvaddakṣiṇato yāti tāvadvāmena śobhane madhye tu niścalaṃ śūnyamayanaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet tadā nirvāṇatāṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā

śūnyasthānāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priye nivṛttimadhyabhāge tu pratiṣṭhā tiryaguttare nādastu pañcamo jñeyaḥ sa śivaḥ parikīrtitaḥ pañcamastu śivaḥ proktaḥ susūkṣmaḥ kathitastava jīvastu nāda ityuktaḥ sparśaśaktimayasmṛtaḥ dvividhena tu deveśi kartavyo'nugrahassadā deyañca gurubhaktāya śivabhaktāya dhīmate mārutaḥ pravahaṃ brūte mantriṇaṃ mokṣakastathā etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi yena vijñātamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ bindunādena jñātavyaṃ śīghragaṃ salilaṃ nadet tena vijñātamātreṇa amṛtatvāya kalpate ākāreṇa yadā bhinnaṃ devadevaṃ sadātane sītakaṃpena hrasvena mukhenaiva karoti yaḥ ḍha ukāravibhāgena śrutvā pāpairvimucyate ākāreṇa tu vinyasya dhyānādutkramate dhruvam adhastādvāyunā dīptamīkāraṃ vahnidevatam śṛṇoti vividhān nādān māsādabhyantareṇa tu tribhirmāsaissa paśyeta pratyakṣaṃ sarvataḥ sthitam abhyāsena tu deveśi niścalaḥ saṃprajāyate ṣaṇmāsānabhyasedyastu uccāmarapuraṃ vrajet saṃvatsareṇa muktātmā bhavetsvacchandamṛtyukaḥ hrasvakāravibhinnasya śṛṇuṣva surasundari udare raktavarṇantu madhyāhne tejamālinam ahanyahani cābhyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ yoginā priye

yogamutpadyate tasya acirādeva yoginaḥ evamādīni cānyāni kuryādākarṣaṇāni ca cittagṛhāṇi ramyāṇi vāhinīśca tathaiva ca ṣaṇmāsayogayuktasya ityetatsamudāhṛtam sthūlātsthūlataro bhūtvā sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraḥ punaḥ hrasvakā vibhinnasya kathitaṃ tava śobhane sakṛtprabhāvaviśadaṃ candrārkagrahaṇaṃ sthitam śūnyamākāśabhūtantu jarāmṛtyuvināśanam kṣutpipāsā vinirmukto nirdvandvacchinna saṃśayaḥ devaiśca satataṃ yāti ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tu paśyate devi bhūteśaṃ gaṇeśaparivāritam dhyānanirmathanāddevi siddhirutpadyate tataḥ dūrasthaśca samīpasthaḥ pīṭhasthaḥ pīṭhavarjitaḥ kiṃ dūramantiko vā'pi dūrāddūratarantu kim atiguhyataraṃ praśnaṃ kenacinnāpi pṛṣṭavān dūrasthaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvayogihitāvaham daśarūpā mayā khyātā sarve dṛśyanti śobhane khaḍgena gacchatastasya draṣṭavyaṃ lakṣamuttamam bījadvayasamāyogājjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ etadvāraṃ mayā khyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ tatvacintakaiḥ tattvayā viditaṃ sarvaṃ mayāpi kathitaṃ tava tvayā devi tathā jñātaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te pīṭhasthaṃ nayanaṃ proktaṃ bindutatvaṃ samāsataḥ jñātavyaṃ yogibhirnityaṃ adhamaṃ yogisiddhidam sarvakarmāṇi kartavyāṇyāśu siddhimavepsatā

śakticeṣṭāvikārāṇi kurute nityameva ca dṛśyā śaktiriti khyātā tvayāpi vihitā tathā yathā bindurmayā khyātaḥ śaktistu viditā tathā uccāraṃ dūramityuktaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane etattasmin mayā khyātaṃ parasyaivāparasya ca etaddevi rahasyantu mayā khyātaṃ samāsataḥ etatpraśnaparaṃ devi sarveṣāmapi cottamam śakticeṣṭāvikāre tu yattvayoktaṃ maheśvara etatpraśnaṃ paraṃ devi sarveṣāmapi cottamam ādhāro nāda ityuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ parikīrtitaḥ sa nādo bindumāśritya śaktinā prerito yadā bindorvarṇāḥ samudbhūtāḥ yataḥ śāstrañca vāṅmayam suṣupta iva cātmānaṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ na bādhate sarvajñānatā śuddhā śivakāyādvinirgatā bindunādasya yā ceṣṭā tatvānāñcaiva suvṛte śakteḥ samaraso devi kathitañcānupūrvaśaḥ tatsarvaṃ śaktinā vyāptaṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ tribhireva tu saṃyuktaḥ sa jīva iti kīrtitaḥ īṣatsparśasamāyukta mukhanāsāpuṭasya tu iti te kathitaṃ devi śaktessamarasaṃ tathā praṇavattrayantu deveśa yogādhyāye yaduktavān dehasthaṃ yajātānteṣāṃ vyomasthañca tathaiva hi adhastātpañcatatvāni brahmoṅkāreṇa pūjayet śivatatve sthitā ye tu nidhanena prapūjayet śivapūjāvidhau paścādyogaṃ seveta yogavit

teṣāṃ sthalaṃ pavitrādyaṃ praṇavena tu dāpayet yasmin pūrvāṇi deveśa kasmin sparśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ jīvasya bhūtasaṃsthasya tristhāne śṛṇu darśanam mucyate nātra sandehaḥ siddhiścaiva na saṃśayaḥ aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrantu pañcavaktraṃ maheśvaram etadrūpaṃ mayā khyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu suvṛte divārātravibhāgena ayane viṣuve tathā uccāraṃ sparśamityete kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ idaṃ tenābhijānante vivadanti parasparam tasmin sthitaḥ śivassākṣāt kathitaṃ tava suvṛte nā śiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ rahasyamidamuttamam tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi vyomapadmamiti proktaṃ vyomaproktaḥ sadāśivaḥ vyomanālasmṛtākāśaṃ diśā patrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ diśā patreṣu deveśi vidyeśān parikalpayet śikhādūrdhvamukhāstasya vyāpakanti vyavasthitāḥ svacchaṃ sunirmalaṃ tejaḥ suṣirajyotiruttamaḥ etacca binduyogantu kathitaṃ tava śobhane atra padme tu vijñeyaṃ yogibhistatra cintakaiḥ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate devi tatvā ye pūrvacoditāḥ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yogavicchrīmān sarvajñatvaṃ prapadyate etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane idaṃ te kathitaṃ devi tārakaṃ jñānamuttamam etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi mānasaṃ manasālokya yaddalaṃ pratipādayet

dhyāyellakṣavaraṃ divyaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ varānane etaddevi samākhyātaṃ dhyānamānasameva tu tadā yogamiti proktaṃ yuktasya varavarṇinī kasmin sandhyā kathaṃ saṃjño bhagavan kathayasva me tvadīyaṃ padmakaṃ devi na dṛṣṭaṃ kenacitpurā anyeva paśusandhānaṃ kathayanti varānane īdṛśaṃ tatvasandhānaṃ na vijñātantu deśikāḥ tadā karmasamarthantu bhavate sādhakeśvaraḥ tadā tatve tu saṃyojya vidhiṃ kuryādaśeṣataḥ uddhṛtyacātmasaṃsthantu kṛtvā tatvavidaṃ śubham vilīnāmāpamadhye tu āpa bhūtāṃ vicintayet evaṃ vai sarvatatvāni karma kṛtvā'nu saṃśayet evaṃ saṃsthitastatra paśunālokyettadā tatvanīlaṃ nayettatvaṃ tatve tatve niyojayet sarvatantreṣu sāmānyaṃ vidhimetatsamārabhet kiṃ tatvaṃ prathamaṃ deva dvitīyañca tathaiva ca tatvantu prathamācāryaḥ tava devi udāhṛtaḥ paśutatveṣu saṃyojya pṛthivyādiṣvanukramāt vidyātatvāspadaṃ kṛtvā yojayetparame pade bhūtātmā tatra bāhyātmā antarātmā tu indriyaḥ bhūtātmā indriyātmā ca paramātmā tathaiva ca bhūtātmā saṃsthito bhūtaiḥ indriyātmā tathendriyaiḥ trirātmānaṃ vinirmuktaṃ caturthaṃ parameśvari tasya sādātmakaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā caiva vibhāgataḥ etatsamāsato devi rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tava
